name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Trump’s non-answer speaks volumes.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We are not stupid. Republicans want a national abortion ban.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2339%2E4032634%2E5iE0gv)
---
So, let me get this straight: During Tuesday night’s debate, when Trump was asked whether or not he would veto a national abortion ban, he refused to give a direct yes or no answer. When moderators clarified that his running mate, JD Vance, has already stated he would veto a national abortion ban, Trump says that he hasn’t spoken to him about it. Really? You haven’t spoken to your VP pick about abortion policy? If we were to be generous, that could mean they’re not taking this critical issue seriously enough to have a concept of a plan for it yet. But we know what’s really going on: They are just trying to avoid admitting their extreme anti-abortion stance to voters, because they know the majority of Americans support abortion rights. We are not stupid. Republicans want a national abortion ban. [**I’ve got more than a concept of a plan to protect abortion rights: Elect Kamala Harris, keep these men out of the White House, and maintain our Senate majority so we can pass national abortion protections. But this race is close, and we need your support to make this plan possible. Will you split a donation of $28 between Harris for President and our campaign to make sure we can stop a national abortion ban?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2645?amount=28&t=8&akid=2339%2E4032634%2E5iE0gv)

Here’s what we **do** know about Trump’s abortion stance:
* He appointed anti-choice Supreme Court justices who overturned Roe v. Wade
* He’s boasted about being the president who “got rid of Roe v. Wade”
* He said there has to be “some form of punishment” for women who get abortions
* And he’s also said he wants to let states monitor women's pregnancies so they can know if they've gotten an abortion

And, again, he has refused to say he would veto a bill that imposes a nationwide ban. That silence is loud. [**It’s no secret that Donald Trump is an anti-abortion extremist. And his plan, conceptual or not, is to ban abortion rights. We can, and we must, stop him. Please pitch in $28 or anything you can right now to support Kamala Harris and our re-election campaign to keep MAGA extremists out of the White House and ensure we have the votes we need to protect abortion rights.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2645?amount=28&t=14&akid=2339%2E4032634%2E5iE0gv) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

## City of College Park Town Hall Tomorrow Your Voice Matters in the City Manager Selection
Dear United College Park Community, The **City of College Park** will be holding a **Town Hall Meeting tomorrow, Friday, September 13, 2024, at 6:00 p.m.** , to receive citizen comments on the selection of our next City Manager. This meeting will take place at **Jack P. Longino City Hall, 3667 Main Street, College Park, GA**. As residents who care deeply about the future of our city, it’s critical we attend and ensure our voices are heard. **Meet the Finalists:** 1\. **Thomas Thomas** Thomas brings over **25 years of experience** in city management, having successfully led cities such as Compton, CA, and Rock Island, IL. He has a proven track record in turning around financially distressed cities, managing budgets upwards of **$251 million** , and leading large-scale revitalization projects. Under his leadership, Compton moved from being identified as the most financially at-risk city in California to full compliance with state audits . His ability to implement zero-based budgeting, negotiate major public-private partnerships, and restore economic health to cities makes him a clear standout for the role. His experience and results speak volumes about his capabilities. _View Mr. Thomas’s full resume_[ _here_](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMyMzE1OTUzMjkyNjQyMDkzLFwiclwiOjEzMjMxNTk1MzY5NzM5MjI2NH0iLCJzIjoiNmFmZTg5NjkxYTY5ZTRiNCJ9) _._ 2\. **James A. Woods** Woods has demonstrated strong leadership in smaller municipalities like Fort Valley, GA, and Dawson, GA. His efforts in securing **$17.5 million in grants** for infrastructure and economic growth and attracting major industry to Fort Valley are notable . While he may not have managed cities on the scale of College Park, his proven ability to grow smaller cities shows promise. _View Mr. Woods’s full resume_[ _here_](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMyMzE1OTUzMjk2ODM2Mzk4LFwiclwiOjEzMjMxNTk1MzY5NzM5MjI2NH0iLCJzIjoiNGRlYmIzNTIzNGU1YzViMSJ9) _._ 3\. **Emmanuel Adediran** Adediran has been serving as **Interim City Manager** for the past eight months. While his tenure has seen challenges in uniting city staff, he has overseen the implementation of several technological advancements aimed at improving public safety, including the installation of smart cameras . However, concerns remain regarding his alignment with the current council and his ability to lead College Park independently in the long term. Earlier this week, a College Park citizen [questioned Adediran's commitment](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMyMzE1OTUzMjk5OTgyMTI3LFwiclwiOjEzMjMxNTk1MzY5NzM5MjI2NH0iLCJzIjoiZTY2MTkwNjA0MjlkYmE1OCJ9) to his duty as interim city manager. _View Dr. Adediran’s full resume_[ _here_](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTMyMzE1OTUzMzA0MTc2NDMyLFwiclwiOjEzMjMxNTk1MzY5NzM5MjI2NH0iLCJzIjoiZTNhZjIwYTMyMGYxMWM2YiJ9) _._ **Does the City Really Want Our Input?** While this Town Hall is presented as an opportunity for community input, we must question how much meaningful discourse can take place within the **limited 30 minutes** allotted for citizen comments. Furthermore, immediately following this brief public input session, the Mayor and City Council have scheduled an **Executive Session** —closed to the public—where we suspect a decision will be made regarding the selection of the City Manager. We must ask: **Is this meeting truly meant for our input, or have decisions already been made?** We encourage you to attend the meeting and make your voice heard. If you are unable to attend, you can still share your thoughts by emailing [**mayorandcouncil@collegeparkga.com**](mailto:mayorandcouncil@collegeparkga.com). Let’s ensure that whoever becomes our next City Manager is someone truly equipped to lead College Park into a prosperous future. **Stay Engaged. Stay United.** Best regards, _The United College Park Team_

This meeting will take place at Jack P. Longino City Hall, 3667 Main Street, College Park, GA. As residents who care deeply about the future of our city, it’s critical we attend and ensure our voices are heard. Meet the Finalists: 1\. Thomas Thomas Thomas brings over 25 years of experience in city management, having successfully led cities such as Compton, CA, and Rock Island, IL. He has a proven track record in turning around financially distressed cities, managing budgets upwards of $251 million , and leading large-scale revitalization projects. Under his leadership, Compton moved from being identified as the most financially at-risk city in California to full compliance with state audits . His ability to implement zero-based budgeting, negotiate major public-private partnerships, and restore economic health to cities makes him a clear standout for the role. His experience and results speak volumes about his capabilities. View Mr. Thomas’s full resume . 2\. James A. Woods Woods has demonstrated strong leadership in smaller municipalities like Fort Valley, GA, and Dawson, GA. His efforts in securing $17.5 million in grants for infrastructure and economic growth and attracting major industry to Fort Valley are notable . While he may not have managed cities on the scale of College Park, his proven ability to grow smaller cities shows promise. View Mr. Woods’s full resume . 3\. Emmanuel Adediran Adediran has been serving as Interim City Manager for the past eight months. While his tenure has seen challenges in uniting city staff, he has overseen the implementation of several technological advancements aimed at improving public safety, including the installation of smart cameras . However, concerns remain regarding his alignment with the current council and his ability to lead College Park independently in the long term. Earlier this week, a College Park citizen to his duty as interim city manager. View Dr. Adediran’s full resume . Does the City Really Want Our Input? Peter, There’s been a lot of analysis about what it will mean for our country if Donald Trump gets a second term in the Oval Office, this time with Project 2025 as his blueprint. The stakes are particularly high for the LGBTQ+ community. Project 2025 targets federal policies that promote equality for the LGBTQ+ community — threatening the health and safety of LGBTQ+ individuals across the country. And you’re here because you understand Donald Trump is not the only risk. Republicans have _already_ been implementing Project 2025’s anti-democracy, anti-freedom agenda with extreme state-level legislation — _including_ policies that attack the LGBTQ+ community. According to the ACLU, there have been 530 bills targeting LGBTQ+ rights _in 2024 alone_ — but more than 75% of Americans actually _support_ laws that protect LGBTQ+ people from discrimination! Gerrymandered maps allow far-right politicians to pursue extreme agendas against the will of the people. In New Hampshire, one of our 2024 priority states, the state legislature passed and the Governor has signed _three_ discriminatory and harmful anti-LGBTQ+ bills into law in this year alone. ACLU-NH describes one of them (HB 1205) as a law that, “categorically bans all transgender girls in grades 5-12 from participating in school sports.”
And in Ohio, where we have endorsed three Supreme Court candidates, the Republican-controlled legislature passed HB68, which bans gender-affirming medical care for transgender youth _and_ transgender women and girls from participating in sports. The bill was actually initially vetoed by the Republican Governor, but the legislature overruled that veto. After several months of even more battles in court, the bill is now law in Ohio.
**Protecting our freedoms is an ongoing battle — and our work will need to continue whether or not Donald Trump is elected. **

The stakes are particularly high for the LGBTQ+ community. Project 2025 targets federal policies that promote equality for the LGBTQ+ community — threatening the health and safety of LGBTQ+ individuals across the country. And you’re here because you understand Donald Trump is not the only risk. Republicans have already been implementing Project 2025’s anti-democracy, anti-freedom agenda with extreme state-level legislation — including policies that attack the LGBTQ+ community. According to the ACLU, there have been 530 bills targeting LGBTQ+ rights in 2024 alone — but more than 75% of Americans actually support laws that protect LGBTQ+ people from discrimination! Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your night!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240912-4-900&t=3&akid=1913%2E135344%2EkKrul3)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

| | | Peter, North Texas Giving Day is underway, with opportunities for _all_ Texans to give until September 19! **What is North Texas Giving Day?** North Texas Giving Day was started by the Communities Foundation of Texas. From September 1-19, Texans are encouraged to give back to their communities by donating to nonprofits. Last year, over $60,000,000 was raised, making North Texas Giving Day the largest community-wide giving event in the nation! **How can you get involved?** Starting today, you can make a donation to the Texans for Vaccine Choice Education Foundation by clicking [here](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTY3ODM3MzA5NDUzOTk4MzQzJmM9dTlmMCZlPTAmYj0xMzYyMDI1MTAzJmQ9czR6OWkwZg==.QJ_NSyuOLlltiSUUWDmO1FgwGR2G5hhyHsvdLC1KbqU)! Share this link with family and friends and encourage others to be a part of this great opportunity to support TFVC’s Education Foundation. **What does your donation to TFVC’s Education Foundation support?** TFVC’s Education Foundation is dedicated to educating all Texans about informed consent, medical privacy, and vaccine choice. Every day, Texans like you face difficult decisions about vaccine mandates in the workplace and at school. That's why we help parents file for vaccine exemptions for their kids and teach citizens about their right to informed consent. **Help us spread the word!** Share [this link](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTY3ODM3MzA5NDUzOTk4MzQzJmM9dTlmMCZlPTAmYj0xMzYyMDI1MTA2JmQ9bDVmOGQzbA==.mq476_hblgvDEoBf_DMO5vL_Vl5qTdjg2u-LZl6206g) today and be a part of our mission to teach citizens how to effectively advocate for pro-medical freedom policies. Your donations during North Texas Giving Day (and every day) help accomplish this mission! A contribution of [$250, $75, or even $20.24](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTY3ODM3MzA5NDUzOTk4MzQzJmM9dTlmMCZlPTAmYj0xMzYyMDI1MTEwJmQ9czZ1OGo5ag==.oP2nT-fCwbtfB3ynPTZbFu-O_9AWZb6ES48TI09ieMA) can provide resources and training to local North Texas communities that will promote vaccine education for all. Will you join your neighbors this giving day to support TFVC?

body:

Look, here’s something that needs to be said:
No Democrat would ever inspire a violent attack on the United States Capitol to overturn the peaceful transfer of power.
Why? Because Democrats believe in democracy.
If you know me, you know I’m an optimist. I truly believe that not just Democrats but the vast majority of Americans believe in our founding ideals, trust our democratic systems, and want to preserve free and fair elections.
But Donald Trump and far too many of his followers (including my self-described ‘MAGA’ opponent) have made it clear that they don’t. We’re facing extraordinary circumstances that require each and every one of us to commit to this fight — not stand by idly and hope it all turns out well.
What we do in November — less than two months from now — will have a lasting impact on our nation. We can either band together and stand up against the forces that seek to tear down our democracy, or we can sit around and let them win.
Today, I’m asking you to take action to protect our democracy by making a donation to my re-election campaign. Your support will go directly towards sending me back to the Senate and holding our Democratic majority — something we absolutely must do if we have any hope of securing democracy for generations to come. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Our next chapter is not yet written, but what we choose to do this November will determine the future of our nation — so thank you for standing with me on this critical issue.
-Tim Kaine

body:
We need more progressive fighters like Katie.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39094%2E3422442%2ECBOYeh)
Derek,
Want to hear a PERFECT breakdown of the affordable housing crisis in the United States?
Katie gave one at a recent Oversight Committee field hearing in Maui, where she spoke about the critical need for affordable housing not just in disaster response, but for _all_ Americans, everywhere.
This is another example of Katie bringing Congress to the people, to focus on issues _for the people_. We’d be a lot better off if we had more leaders like her in Congress, who focus squarely on what communities need, not what corporations want. **[Will you chip in $5 to help elect more Congressmembers who will put American families first?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240912?refcode=em20240912-39094&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39094_3422442_CBOYeh&akid=39094%2E3422442%2ECBOYeh)**
A persistent shortage of affordable housing is already a crisis for families. When disaster strikes, it can spiral into a full-brown catastrophe.
Unfortunately, Maui’s long recovery from last year’s wildfires is a perfect example of what happens when policymakers don’t center families’ biggest problems, like affordable housing, _before_ disaster comes along.
As Katie said in the hearing, “Competition with tourists—mainlanders scooping up properties to rent as vacation homes—combined with a lack of new construction played a part in putting stable, affordable housing out of reach for many of the families who live and work here. The wildfires _supercharged_ Maui’s housing crisis.”
The housing crisis is playing out in communities from from Maui to Miami, wildfires are raging right now across the western United States, and forecasts earlier this year predicted a record-breaking hurricane season.
Our lawmakers can’t keep kicking the can on housing and climate. Katie’s working hard so that all Americans can afford the housing they deserve, but we need more leaders like her. That’s where you come in.
We’re working to elect a new wave of Democrats who will do the job of Congress the way Katie does, prioritizing action on the issues that matter most to families: **[Will you chip in $5 or more right now to help?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240912?refcode=em20240912-39094&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39094_3422442_CBOYeh&akid=39094%2E3422442%2ECBOYeh)**

Thanks,
Team Truth to Power

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240912-39094&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39094_3422442_CBOYeh&akid=39094%2E3422442%2ECBOYeh)**

subject: Clint St. Mosley, Update from Michigan's 9th Congressional District
body:
Clint St. Mosley Campaign Update, Michigan's 9th Congressional District | | | | |
---
|
# Greetings from the Campaign Trail!
---
| We’ve been traveling across Michigan’s 9th Congressional District meeting with voters and Democratic clubs, and without a doubt, enthusiasm for the Democratic ticket with Kamala Harris/Tim Walz is off the charts! At nearly every event we attend, turnout has been packed and people are motivated to get out the vote!
It’s truly amazing – and I am forever grateful for all who are supporting our campaign!
**Georgia Shooting** Our hearts go out to the families of Apalachee High School near Winder, Georgia where four innocent lives were lost to gun violence last week. It brought back a lot of painful memories of the 2021 Oxford High School shooting where several close friends had children hiding from the 15-year-old shooter while frantically texting their parents.
It also reminded me how our current representative Lisa McClain came to Oxford High School to offer her thoughts and prayers, after having voted against a bipartisan federal red flag law just months earlier.
This is not the world I want my kids to grow up in – we can and must do better.
**Kamala Harris Debate** My wife and I enjoyed Tuesday’s Harris/Trump debate! Her performance was a masterclass in poise and skill as she described how Democrats have the backs of working families and talked about the Opportunity Economy that will grow our economy from the bottom up, and middle out to revive the middle class.
It was also a proud moment across Michigan’s 9th Congressional District knowing we are one giant leap closer to seeing the end of the Trump/MAGA era!
The debate also shows how out-of-touch my Trump-endorsed MAGA Republican opponent Lisa McClain really is. She opposes gun safety at every turn, she votes against labor rights and pension protections, and thinks local sheriffs and governments should decide who gets access to reproductive healthcare.
But she does support is Gas and Oil drilling in the Great Lakes, Betsy DeVos and dismantling the U.S. Department of Education – she even voted AGAINST certifying the 2020 election to help support Donald Trump’s election lies.
[**DONATE TO FLIP CD-9!**](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=a03eabdfb4&e=21c900a6be)
**Closing the Vote Gap** The good news is, with every percentage point Kamala Harris picks up, we’ll pick up between 2,500 and 3,000 voters to close the gap that is narrowing every day.
So how will we close the gap? We’ll target:
√ Women voters in Oakland County with reproductive rights and gun/school safety
√ Union Workers in Macomb County to end Trickle-Down Economics and launch the Opportunity Economy
√ Rural Farmers hurt by Trump tariffs, supporting rural broadband grants and protecting Social Security
√ Retirees along Lake Huron about protecting their property values, retiree benefits and Medicare costs
And we’ll say hello to the 56,285 18- to 25-year-old Swifties in our district!
We feel good, we feel strong, and we’re ready to take the fight to Lisa McClain!
**Our Donor-Funded Campaign** At a lot of our meetings with supporters, people often assume the DNC or the Michigan Democratic Party is funding our campaign. What most people don’t realize is that upstart campaigns like ours almost never get financial support from the party.
So we are always having to make tough choices between getting more lawn signs out to volunteers, printing more canvass lit, or buying targeted digital/social media advertising to close the voter gap I mentioned above.

_**Her response was typical of a politician who knows they’re in trouble: distract and attack. It’s a classic.**_
[**We need your help to keep this ad running.**](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=493ebad89c&e=784f78234b)

| This is about more than her absenteeism—it’s about holding Terra Lawson-Remer accountable for the disastrous policies that have led to a historic rise in homelessness and record homeless deaths across San Diego. While homelessness went down under my leadership, it has surged every year since Lawson-Remer took office.
We need to keep the pressure on and ensure every voter knows about her failure to act on homelessness and her dangerous pattern of not showing up for work. But, we can’t do it without your support.
[Will you pitch in $25, $50, or even $100 today to keep this ad on the air? ## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv0ll7h2qkj8rrhs1t6m1g62ddh4h867d5t8pheo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c9h68or5c9h2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5sq878vuqaulldnkkhhsju95kouiij5oqodvpt8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c9h68or5c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. name: Connor Boyack
subject: Controversial? Our nation's problems are bigger than a single election.
body:
This may seem controversial to say, but it’s true: Our nation's problems are bigger than a single election.

|
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2sfigtsstjpj5h9j4rein6bt709pebmgu3ljlsg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c9h68or5c5h2bs "Tuttle Twins")
Friend,

This may seem controversial to say, but it’s true: Our nation's problems are bigger than a single election.

I'm not saying elections aren't important, but politics is downstream from culture. The real issues facing our nation are cultural issues, and the left has control of the main indoctrination tools — the media and the education system.

We’ll never solve the issues facing our country by trying to outsmart them at their own game. We need to come up with a different approach. A grassroots approach, which is exactly what we have done.

My name is Connor Boyack, the author of _The Tuttle Twins_. These books bring families together to teach the next generation about the values of liberty, American history, free markets, and limited government.

[My mission is to get Tuttle Twins books in as many schools people as possible! I set a goal to raise $20,000 before the end of the month. Every $20 we raise allows us to send a copy of a Tuttle Twins book. Please click here to give today.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfi2ah2vgge2t1bee2p4jcdpa94end04hm98i9ho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c9h68or5c5h2bs)
[Give a Tuttle Twins Book](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5n7v8v0hpesa1mk7mtcu47op8jcd14i372ksf10_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c9h68or5c5h2bs)
**So far, we’ve distributed over 6 MILLION copies of _the Tuttle Twins_!** [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zrheirbe676hnc56tdi0fa9jk8pmhe4kcn2315f0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3c9h68or5c5h2bs)
_The Tuttle Twins_ series is more than just a collection of children's books — they're a vital tool in the fight for a better tomorrow. Each story breaks down complex ideas about economics, liberty, and personal responsibility in a way that's fun and engaging for kids.

**By presenting these ideas in a simplified, attractive, and fun format, we can appeal to a new generation and help them understand and apply these powerful ideas.**

The lessons learned in _the Tuttle Twins_ books stick with children for the rest of their lives, turning them into productive and responsible citizens and changing the culture in this country for decades to come.

Every dollar you give will help us put these life-changing books into the hands of more kids, sparking the curiosity and understanding that leads to a brighter, freer future for all.

name: Freedom First Project
subject: Get them before they're canceled
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)Dear Fellow American, Recently, I read about a Massachusetts high school teacher who posted on social media that she's: "Very proud to say we got the _Odyssey_ removed from the curriculum this year!" Homer and the legendary Odysseus are just the latest casualties in a systematic purge of classic literature and stories from school curriculums. These cancelations rob our young of classic tales of adventure and friendship, where young people can learn timeless truths about the world and how best to live--something many Americans cannot agree on in the first place. Books like these are rare, and the best of them are revised, ignored, or removed in most of today's schools. In response, Hillsdale College launched a free online course entitled **" Classic Children's Literature."** Perhaps you've had a chance to watch a few lectures. [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._fjGPdKq9RJa0_f5w)**Today, I 'm excited to tell you that the course is now available on DVD! And you can reserve your copy today.** The box-set is an excellent gift for parents, homeschool families, and anyone who cherishes an exciting and profound story. **" Classic Children's Literature"** explores some of the greatest works of children's literature from Aesop and the classic fairy tale stories through the works of A.A. Milne, Robert Louis Stevenson, and more. In this course, you'll learn how these great books delight audiences of all ages, produce a sense of wonder, and teach timeless lessons to the young and old alike. The DVD box-set includes lessons on _Beauty and the Beast, The Snow Queen, Alice 's Adventures in Wonderland, Treasure Island_, and more. This course has brought great joy to my family, as it has inspired us to read through the classic works covered in this course together. I hope you can share this same experience with your loved ones as you learn more about what makes these beloved stories so important. **You can get your DVD box-set of "Classic Children's Literature" by making a tax-deductible gift of $100 to Hillsdale College using this secure link:** **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-classic-childrens-literature-today](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._z-MuFuOwZGOgJgfOsaA)** Thank you again for your support of Hillsdale College and for partnering with us to educate our fellow citizens, especially our youngest citizens. Without you, Hillsdale could not offer these courses free of charge to any person willing to learn. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09Director of Online LearningHillsdale College|

body:
Can you spare a minute of your time?

Friend,

I need you **[to act right now to make a huge difference](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSoc9OMvW4jGgO2D7BGEAofuAFbpz1ivD80Gq9-YOkWTlgNUZB6zRTbp_RAmPSi566-gYQ4Zb3q_rymipF3bgwyMdL7Oj--dIrZA42Sx_1Gx4z-zGv9jNZ4r9XKQS_ab1cxBRWAkguBhvVclZPI_yE0mU%3D)** in a critical U.S. Senate race.

My friend and fellow Republican Senator, **[Deb Fischer](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSoeE2S3lpP-OLA89xrOJkIJSuBQQr26QZOKMH9DF33vh9HzyitbuXQoAU_X8KN-TH-RSqbu82aZE1DqpyBCJ_O8NAjUkWzORBnWYpo7jTKLxZ_xJudwfbIk6bEqRlIM0u7U121bDArnPJI9mvB2szceo%3D) **of Nebraska, is facing a tough challenge from Kamala Harris, Chuck Schumer, and the rest of the Democrats.

They know that if they defeat her, they'll keep the majority -- **[help us stop that from happening.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSoYRjV4prH2mAqRwAWwWOlg7989PeCrF0SbM0WSb-sWtV49JonyUud8a_4TM1FctJNTrNFQSv-hN_wuWqizZn_xi1Jbr29mNAyj16rm75j9mv0PoNvWYgJnSI5yEbovKeKgLTEIVKyYBEGIVBun-XMHc%3D)**

Take it from me, if we're going to make America strong again, we need Deb Fischer back in the Senate. I serve with her on the Armed Services Committee, and I know firsthand how important her leadership is to America's security.

Friend, we can't afford to lose her in the Senate -- _and we can 't afford to lose the majority._

**[Will you help Deb Fischer win in November? Donate any amount here to help her win.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSoZWIT7eRSzCfQqRc_SHxSk59YDiZh1ZVKHpcLp-HbLtGkbtf9SPPees0mr1-AIcHyPlMORsQoiTxYlRKRFn7w2UlrgwsmwE2c70Eh2K3sg8TcL37uwtd0Yu8bKfXpMAsUL3E4pVznon4ZX-xE4Kl33o%3D)**

_**[Friend, to take back the majority, we need to flip two seats -- and we also have to hold the seats we already have, like Deb's.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSoaLzZ-_WJvs4083zlSKMd41qcX9-xH88pP35AA3MGhgZwREanzGjK2voco7B6NbK8HCs6lKNaR24165a1QNarMiCcm7PIgtKqrnx_69JJHhYJgn3B5OpsxcyOYqUelk39SpEFqL2tTENF6QrdbkB6Zw%3D)**_

But Democrats are outraising Republicans _**[by hundreds of millions nationwide.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSoRukK92Nlx3hXkEN-3HV6Pq0YOWLMkR7kuG9bYMmGSh0E8vJtu3sEePIKxHCUlrGrFYJgx35wHnzU5xYEew5KYYgNxmob21udYAZzQ6r4md_qjolEAQ-ABNPrDkPNFC_oyzVe3PnXOdC-Nn8n1npoVE%3D)**_

With less than two months until Election Day, it's time for tough conservatives to step up.

**[We must secure the resources we need to break through the Democrats' lies and the liberal media's spin.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12563f53860040d8b4bcb3416ce77ba7&_e=SRVr_RumJpAIDLZnUTgzlbUXOt3hqym1gxUSgfgNogqWAGJYn4YtD_XaZAWrbUfPfAlpmqrkMVocPg2t-hNJm3vDf65Fy1DlEZbJyLx6KQSJ_PWacv1qMExvKK6C1Bzr5EJ8JZveBRifjwyxA8t-kMy7DLusA_WPu34eq5-ft6gYONnRqqc6mDQoz1W8hBymMAD9On0wIuIIERw0OdKoKJgGE0M20horP-GAFbMPeHmYoY21g6P3zL0MTAX4yKkGecdAIl9l6kY1iWWldxvUBqLJlabM8-4yX91Kj0HtCe5K5yfZL-ZHdFVSlHCa6fmI3eVIHXNbZje8Llgba2CSofsSQxuWiueiOBL7mL4xU97hocZAQUYL4ndlrxLTDtu870hlwpEJU0Ykq7M5L0ttBEQcYA9v-DaZXA33P3d3y51Cdr9VEfRPXMknh5TstHqpNpyArBBH6SCXtG5-udocn9i7vpJkWF1qoKaiMim578s%3D)**

And it starts with us. # [After the debate, the media can no longer ignore Trump's mental decline](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3459b954-baab-4ebb-9bfe-3e1e83341268/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | **The debate made it clear -- Donald Trump is losing it,[and his mental decline can no longer be ignored.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8223a8eb-15fe-45dd-8827-2bc02d51b251/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** His answers were rambling and incoherent. He mixed up and made up names ([Abdul](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6892cce2-7da1-42dd-a08f-8c667d1e502d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)?). He is dangerously detached from reality, and putting him back in the White House would put the nation in grave peril. **And yet, most mainstream media sources seem incapable of saying this.** Instead, they dance around the elephant in the room, use euphemisms, and edit and "sane-wash" Trump's words so they seem not so crazy. This has to end, and it has to end now. Reporters need to stop normalizing Trump's behavior, and admit there is a big, big problem. Tens of millions of us already see it, but tens of millions more have just started paying attention to the campaign. But it's just a matter of weeks until Election Day, and people need to know what's at stake when they vote. And this can only happen if reporters actually report the facts. It's like getting the band back together.
Lev Parnas, Stephanie Winston Wolkoff, Anthony Scaramucci, and Michael Cohen are joining me on Wednesday, September 25, 2024 in New York City to make the case for why Elise Stefanik should never be elected to serve in our government again.
Please private message me if you are interested in the details.
More events with Lev Parnas are in the works in key places within New York's 21st Congressional District. Stay tuned. We're taking our case to the voters.
Why would four nationally-recognized, former Trump inner-circle movers and shakers team up with my campaign?
Because they, of all people, know.
They know that Elise Stefanik prances around the halls of the Rayburn House Office Building solely to promote her own agenda, rather than to meet the needs of the NY-21 voters who put her there.
They know that Elise Stefanik has a toxic relationship with most other elected officials in Washington, making it impossible for her to work collaboratively for the benefit of the NY-21 voters who rely on her for her representation.
They know that Elise Stefanik has pledged support to Donald Trump that will result in the complete and total destruction of our democracy - all for the benefit of Elise Stefanik and Donald Trump.
They know - better than any other group of people - that Elise Stefanik presents a clear and present danger to our democracy.
A vote for Elise Stefanik is a proxy vote for Donald Trump.
Even if Donald Trump is defeated in November, his sycophant Stefanik will continue to sow dysfunction, discord, and disruption in the halls of Congress if she is allowed to keep her seat this November.
Stefanik supports things like the January 6 Insurrectionists - she calls them hostages.
She stirs the pot with things like the impeachment of Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas.
She grandstands in ego-driven but destructive displays, like the incendiary interrogations of private university presidents following campus protests - none of which are in her home district - all designed to advance her national platform rather than advance the needs of the people who sent her to Congress.
She voted against the American Rescue Plan, but still claims credit for the money it brings into her district.
She supports abortion bans, but still claims to represent the needs of women in her district.
She supported the defeat of the bipartisan immigration bill, but claims it is the Biden administration that is to blame for the border crisis.
She claims to be pro-military, but voted against the PACT Act.
She claims to support the middle class, but is not in support of the PRO Act.
She claims to support education, but backs Project 2025 which touts a plan to dismantle the Department of Education.
I'm doing everything in my power to make sure that Elise Stefanik is not re-elected to Congress.
Lev Parnas, Stephanie Winston Wolkoff, Anthony Scaramucci, and Michael Cohen are joining me.
Will you?
Even if you can't be with us in the room when we get the band back together, you can help my campaign. Donate at [www.paulacollinsforcongress.com](https://substack.com/redirect/4258e669-2b78-4372-a354-8a42cfa29620?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or mail a check to Paula Collins for Congress; 441 Old State Road; DeKalb Junction, NY 13630.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

body:
Can you spare a minute of your time?

Friend,

I need you **[to act right now to make a huge difference](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCKYO01QwJp5a9GkN2xMRl4nMWNQT5pjIMSyVA9vPJtDdJtyWxh9HfTJltDQL3Z93jtXh88s59cyD7RM0RGpR8BVGUsEuXYomOjIU-mGrqiRyAJUhFlxtOX12I0WglysgahntTel_BevH7tGRFOj3cEk%3D)** in a critical U.S. Senate race.

My friend and fellow Republican Senator, **[Deb Fischer](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCBMBPjr4kd7LqPpQQ-rD3Xu0H6Wdl8ONRGRk9cRLvTLDkbYxMP3BKZHVTMnOOzWPCHzH-z4yfOSYmrC7GdjCtqmXFKO6JKAkjvzNSoYziNUIF0EPgwWlAd0cuyEV5xqeNysdEEs6a0qE4tkc5cElAxs%3D) **of Nebraska, is facing a tough challenge from Kamala Harris, Chuck Schumer, and the rest of the Democrats.

They know that if they defeat her, they'll keep the majority -- **[help us stop that from happening.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCJtQypLV5KftKEIjbneAmSn2GIKjHU0C6_TGwDKOzmhv_zqlHsPh0KqBJMP9sBCqFHKNjj93P4RGLDTOs9D8IsuvfZ6qI5JAlJSpCGv1ashBe-CNIg_I-0lFtskcHjEXcrw5rUFt0apEfXvk4HNone0%3D)**

Take it from me, if we're going to make America strong again, we need Deb Fischer back in the Senate. I serve with her on the Armed Services Committee, and I know firsthand how important her leadership is to America's security.

Friend, we can't afford to lose her in the Senate -- _and we can 't afford to lose the majority._

**[Will you help Deb Fischer win in November? Donate any amount here to help her win.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCOcR0Held-Z1DRuqtgvmXS758XXLC2ExqKkZWsmfZZMxup2mIg9DE45Gau0N_LQ7E9tEgw_MiIbTvpuBULWe2nt3G_mQcm39ajyTt50n43wztPLV5UDjXHczhyH4vpTgxZQvnSEacAJUreIzDvwkjtU%3D)**

_**[Friend, to take back the majority, we need to flip two seats -- and we also have to hold the seats we already have, like Deb's.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCBgPTRdqhO9eSJiiSb0OM88JynFQP6jgelx17909S8GsNVS8Rfw2yU1GiooOLCChG0NWXa7SgqSGG0i-vOBxNUX0_niX0vJb9H7DWw0gDalN_U81hJ0DNB9Xzfs8Q3pjD4YHfG9PVD8vftXqix8CLZM%3D)**_

But Democrats are outraising Republicans _**[by hundreds of millions nationwide.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCD-ivCEUdR60qWwxuUniCLJs3UJ2tJ01qbpSnk6ngWkY8jIppnyi_dp3O0jHLJ2qVMsswlEAadfzyCTn-L3TtfGhWMpXjnd6by1uuvWBAoJA-2WdoPKd6TdwCk4u1UmEVK7MoXIhQPrnpdf8QvY3QN4%3D)**_

With less than two months until Election Day, it's time for tough conservatives to step up.

**[We must secure the resources we need to break through the Democrats' lies and the liberal media's spin.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCOUkhAFC8Jvz6h-J_yo2vCm5B_r_B0JmiQThNc0FsKkGfTJhwRST1yiWvMEdNj0HuBNEBfkh5H308tFMlvSs-C6TZiThSmKBABlpbUA4D1CLc34odpBs3al0Q5xosS44nNGvTBK8V0HiJsWDJHSbSB4%3D)**

And it starts with us. It starts with you. **[If you can, I'm asking you to donate *any amount* as soon as you can to help Deb Fischer win, and to help Republicans take back the Senate.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a7d6e00bfa814512bdcb37e8f896da58&_e=yXnkspS0NJhGA-0-eBJfGY1Rwt-D6_cEisA1DjdqXNXk5DepgeVD2O8XrVx_-7csTaEL07nDmWph7IYVdbMa2ud9Lk3MCj7yjx8-h9YUhmyXI0QbrtPTNu25b6kfK0sZrXkPgzJja7hsMGMXVgewzLO8TZhSXFV6jih6VbDtyNedAW4vVfTuxGxL6rOlPmYgilI2nS2Dt8URr9AlgjuJwnamyLGHpEGoOZqjrALgX_154uAX3cNiOJEy59_4p1mZhkoOnokg6hzTbtvz67HeZpUNN9FGWDKhBzP_H9x28lD1TV6Td9F2QrPwTw1hGg6LOZ0pbjgOP8TEmPu4i4hiCClCPcG48A5JEMg33BR4XhLrBe1Nsw5koLzk6sM-APu2K_MzsF7KItRp8B48i_hIiizwP-2JyeYdfOX9wKv1mEq2X49eU2xKwsXk4AnKuOqpQe-smAvQUDNNuDOCk1R_u3EJC767qE-sUL308fj8sq0%3D)**

body:
Billionaire Jared Isaacman and SpaceX engineer Sarah Gillis made history Thursday by completing the world's first all-civilian spacewalk. # FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 13, 2024
---|---

body:
Peter,As we approach November, let me ask you:**Are you better off today than you were ten years ago?** If the answer is no, you're not alone. Brad Schneider has been in office for a **decade** , and in all that time, he's passed **zero laws.** While families in the 10th District are struggling with skyrocketing prices for groceries, gas, and childcare, Brad's been busy **pandering to the far left of his party** , never wanting to rock the boat with them--even though his own party barely notices him. He avoids taking a stand, even when it means **your family is left to bear the brunt of misguided policies.** But this November, you have a choice.Jim Carris is not here to follow the status quo. He's a business leader who's spent decades signing both sides of the paycheck, **cutting costs, creating jobs, and running successful companies. **Jim knows what it takes to strengthen our economy, and he values **independence** and **intellectual integrity** over blind party loyalty.While Brad Schneider has made it clear he's more interested in staying in his party's good graces than delivering for you, Jim Carris is focused on putting the people of the 10th District **first**. He'll fight for families, small businesses, law enforcement, and working people--regardless of political pressures.[The time for change is now.](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-sqhtjd-tlidtddjku-r/) This November, you can vote for a candidate who **prioritizes results over party politics**. **Jim Carris is ready to deliver real solutions for the challenges you face.** Can you help us make this change? **Even the smallest amount will make a big difference.** We don't have the PACs and mega-donors Brad has, but we do have something much more powerful: **you**. **Good morning!** On this day in 1883, free-grass cattle raisers [cut the fences](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z72OhCAUxfGngU5zuXytBcU2drPtlgblqiQoEyQ6vv1mpt_qV52T_H8fw8PHFPflx2_k6mvOg59qPGnoGiEbVIPiwY0QOsHJCYsGJQBYvrowidkq-dXNs9TaSEmevESrNNE0kuXRIaCCTkgB2qBpQYwBFegOjNKjBaaAQqy5tHWlSi9_zOnOJ5V2yhtPbq31eTD5zbBn2F_X1dZj9XlPcac2l4Vh_1k1wd_NeL9h2NNey1uNkhcXnldMKR7GMgXL5mP6nNd_Wk-HfwEAAP__aKNWIA) of Mabel Doss Day's 85,000-acre ranch in Coleman County for their drought-stricken herds. ## Texas Supreme Court Sides With Citizen Group
The Texas Supreme Court ordered the City of Dallas to remove three of its [proposed charter amendments](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL-OpSAUxp8Gu2PgiLIWFNvYzbZbmiMcRxKQG-DqzNtv7k22nPL7V3y_vx_rB4UYzs8_lNi2rz2v5Fq4eJ1BDYB61Z23m_Sz6tgqgxMOUkrTHdY7YkWafhkiM22IpMlI2tQ8jX432AWLErWc1aDkOOHUS7V51HKc5aTHzUihJfvQcunbwY2_qO7xO19cepdTF-3R2qOK4bfAReBy33fvtnryXV-5wOU9Ebi8rP8S6vNRODG4_CwNyjNyhXDCTlcukHc4uGTwFCNVcKF9v4qnCxFy8VzYQ8tQOOWLYQB3UGlcgBKfPvHZKuwlJzjzBRvFmJvApSvWP-4QY6iTEVp-JgrxfaH9QPSy-C8AAP__AXV9IA) from the November ballot, finding they conflicted with citizen-led initiatives and would mislead voters. The three amendments--requiring the city to increase police pay and hire more officers, tying the city manager's pay to performance, and allowing citizens to sue city officials if they break the law--closely mirrored those brought by the advocacy group Dallas HERO. However, the city's versions included language clarifying that the council would [have the final say](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvozAQhH-N6TayFwOicHEN3bv2ysjYm4clm0X2hpf8-xPpXz3fjGbm39f9y6ec9u-_vpCT14PvPkg66T6D6QHt3XbRrTrOpiNnJhyx11pP3eZmv5oQg-6jsdPgV4pWm2kc44D9HLDvkkONVs-mN3oYcbxps0a0epj1aId10spqikm43mQjoZdvj_zmk-otcOmy20SOpvo_CheFSzsoSH2WzMHnnX7aRSlc5HWJ_JQNPhlAGQ7fWOFycE6SQlO4XFUULnpWuBi8bB-2PY9KhSDwswpwjVQbhCRv4AdEn7NvIAyVCp8EslUi8IX2WGiXBo_KBWQj2PmkslKF1efM0lUXj5-Uc2rjpKz-Lj7lzyr55eTT4f8AAAD__75hgdo) on how to allocate money. Dallas HERO's proposed amendments will stay on the ballot as drafted. After the ruling, the group's [executive director said](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOnDAQQL_GdLMaD8ZeCoo0dJc2JRrs4bBk45XxweXvo2x_9ZOe9N6fj-WDY4rH52_OMrXvrSzsW7xkGUH3QGYxXZhWDKPuZNKOLPWI6Lp92vyovbEDOq8de-6lRxErorXg4EwXJ0IyOOpe42DJPlCvgQwOI1ozrA6VQQmxlfpouzT55nNLf8sl9eFL7tK0t_Y6Vf9L0axovu_7cW_M_6GimWuLPomi-ZD7VDSn4jkpmt8iOL9eVbKAL1-1QalB6gmBU-ITquRyCbS9ioDfuTapwFmOkOVoJ2y1ZDjKJXmVCiunVJqimZ4OVhOsW8MAY68tmCdpeCIHEEvyxKE3nm1Xp_C6Y0rxtE4Z_Mwc0zup_XD4muhfAAAA__8f033C) the "city council's duplicitous attempt to thwart the will of the people was reckless, unlawful, and disgraceful."

If I win my race, it’ll be the first time any of those people will see someone who looks like them representing our state in the U.S. Senate. I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. [If you’ve got my back and are ready to make that happen, could you make a split donation of $10 with Blue Amp Action to help us win this race? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tff8aae83-5a1d-4b31-a38c-d556083364b6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Kids who grow up the way I did don’t make their way to the U.S. Senate. Statistically speaking, I never should’ve made it to college. But thanks to my mom, my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard. I served in the Marines, and I fought in Iraq. I came back, and I got elected to Congress. I served almost 10 years, fighting for my people. And now, I’m taking on Kari Lake and the MAGA-right to defend Arizona and take back a critical seat in the U.S. Senate. Talking heads have been telling us for months that this race would come down to the wire, and right now the polls are narrowing considerably. It’s a fight to the finish. What I need more than anything else is the resources to fight back against the waves of attacks and ads coming my way. To win, I need you to join me in this fight. With you, we can do it. Without you, I don’t have a shot. [Please, can you afford to chip in $10 and help me become the first Latino Senator from Arizona? A Senator for ALL Arizonans, no matter what party they belong to or what country their family came from.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93ef9e21-d9e5-4a80-9c8b-7bc0a83f6d22/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

# Debate in Philly
---
Tuesday night had all eyes on Philadelphia as the Republican and Democratic nominees for president battled it out in a televised debate held at the National Constitution Center. The most striking difference was that one candidate could coherently answer questions and had policy ideas, while the other candidate rambled on about illegal immigrants getting transgender operations, people eating dogs, and ‘concepts’ of plans (kinda weird, right!). But we wanted to look at what they had to say about abortion care:
---
The Republican candidate continued to repeat what he said abortion during his June debate, stating that legal scholars wanted Roe V Wade overturned and that most voters wanted the issue returned to the state. **[Both of these statements are false](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMTHpY68KeBL-tuPFtNUwAZQpBFi_85_vgJ9bGZrHe1IFbPxADk8A5hCP7TNTFg8INWBIMv9QHDLkbOHH3st35x_aYDGqpiuC6Q_wSxkMviWZwbo1Kd0TurBaowssLdNd5yPPifpixKrxEz4rOLG54X6nNi-GNXvgRH4lj3YXs2wklBjmyJAJb_6pD2RbuXASoiV1VEbofrzHOrtVKO40Bz3hXom9PobrzWI844Y5bFCoxiHeL175HR2sWSBzbl__rPexSjCLWS2VLdMgW_VvaSLnRy2ojqa-AAFgxppHz3XGdez9j2V42lt4GeiCgsOsEjVTCTGmxfx2mZW_PZezuCA/49q/1NFalMRZTQSpNFmPLhQiXA/h3/h001.HNY70gP_-ZJtoZijGfy6vod2ooiUygx_1S_DTTfxY7A)**. Whereas the Democratic candidate stated condemned state-level abortion bans and said she would proudly reinstate the protections fought for under Roe v Wade The Republican candidate repeated the lie that some states allow abortions to be performed after a baby has been born. This is not happening anywhere and is unequivocally false. Moderators even pointed out to him that this was not happening. In contrast, the Democratic candidate, responded by sharing stories of women not being able to get the reproductive health care they needed or are being forced to carry unwanted/unviable pregnancies to term because of restrictive laws enacted by Republican led state legislatures

It’s important you download it ASAP as anti-gun groups are trying to get rid of it.

Downloading this certification online ensures you encounter:

* **Zero** lines, classroom time or books to read...
* **Zero** gun range time (You don’t even need to fire a gun to [**get this certification**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18585/6374453/b569aedbfeaf853061ecfcfe8b220a9e8a5920a6/751f0d308e0488333dc8d2007fe95e6f91424a1a)).

You don’t even need to own a gun to get this certificate...
that’s why it’s been named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Certificate.

31 states have agreed to accept this certificate so far (it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized certificate that’s available right now).

This certification permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry certification permit either. It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.

→ But there is one thing you need to know...

Since it is so easy to get this certificate, pro-gun-control lawmakers are aggressively searching for ways to ban access to it.

As such, you’ll need to download your online certificate today... especially since tomorrow this fast-track site could be shut down for good.

If you ever thought about getting a concealed carry certificate here is your chance to carry legally. If you think you know some “gun basics” [**click here and download the certification today**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18585/6374453/b569aedbfeaf853061ecfcfe8b220a9e8a5920a6/751f0d308e0488333dc8d2007fe95e6f91424a1a).

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1914%2E135344%2EuI9J1_)

Friend --
The presidential race has understandably received a lot of attention over the past few weeks.
But I am writing to ask you to return your focus to the other two branches of government, the legislative branch and the Supreme Court.
The U.S. Senate confirms Supreme Court justices, and will almost certainly vote on the confirmation of one (or more!) Supreme Court justices over the next several years.
The past few years have been a reminder of the perils of ignoring the Supreme Court, not to mention the dozens of lower courts whose decisions affect our lives.
And if we lose the Senate race here in Michigan, Republicans will almost certainly take control of the U.S. Senate and have the power to confirm extreme nominees put forward by Donald Trump or block those advanced by Kamala Harris.
What’s more, the Supreme Court could rule on any number of issues in the next several years, from environmental protections to gun violence prevention to birth control and IVF. And one of the only significant ways to push back on political Supreme Court decisions is to actually legislate these issues in the Senate. While the Supreme Court has been reversing issues based only in case law, like Roe v. Wade, it’s significantly harder to change things that are actually voted into law.
[**If the future of the Supreme Court is worth $3 to you, that is the donation I am asking you to make today. I know that it seems crazy that $3 could make a difference in a race as expensive as this one, but by the time you make your $3 contribution, lots of other people will have done the same. #

Trump coming to Arizona this soon after his last visit —**he attacked me directly at both rallies** — changes our race in a big way.
Trump’s renewed focus on Arizona is happening because he knows he has to win this state. That makes our mission of winning back Arizona’s U.S. Senate seat that much more difficult, because Trump’s attention is going to bring tons more outside spending and attention from the MAGA-right. Money, support, media, staff, you name it.
This kind of strategic shift, this late in the race... it’s really bad news. I’m not going to sugarcoat this. It could really impact our chances.
And, I’ve got to tell you, if we don’t pick up our fundraising right now we’re not going to be able to compete. If we don’t make some serious progress on our goals over the next few weeks... Well, let’s just hope we do.
I don’t even want to consider the alternative. So, I’m going to be direct here.
[**I need you to give $5, $25, maybe even $100 or more if you can afford it. USO Supporter,
I wanted to take a moment to share a story that truly highlights the impact of your contributions to the USO.
As a former Army Logistics Officer, I've seen firsthand how the USO touches the lives of our service members in ways that go beyond the battlefield. One day, while at a local dog park, I noticed someone wearing a USO hat. It caught my eye immediately because that logo and those three letters hold so much meaning for me. I just had to say something.
| **[GET YOUR HAT](https://links.e.uso.)**
---
********
[](https://links.e.uso.)
I introduced myself and, as it turns out, the person wearing the hat was a USO employee. We shared stories about the times the USO was there for us when we needed it most -- whether it was a care package, a cup of coffee, or just a friendly face at the airport. It was a small moment, but it reminded me of the incredible network of support the USO provides, all thanks to people like you.
The hat that sparked our conversation symbolizes something much bigger than just an organization -- it represents a community of supporters who stand behind our service members every step of the way.
[**That 's why I'm excited to share with you a special opportunity: for a limited time, when you donate $20 or more to support our heroes, you can receive your very own USO hat. **](https://links.e.uso.)
Wearing this hat isn't just about keeping the sun out of your eyes; it's a way to show your ongoing support for our service members. It's a way to say, "I stand with those who serve."
[**By donating today, you not only support the programs and services that help our service members and their families, but you also get to wear that support with pride.**](https://links.e.uso.)
Thank you for being a crucial part of our mission. Your generosity makes stories like mine possible and helps ensure that the USO can continue to be there for those who need it most.
With gratitude for military supporters,
Claudia W.
Former Army Logistics Officer
P.S. Don't miss out on this chance to proudly wear your support. [**Donate today and get your USO hat as a token of our appreciation.**](https://links.e.uso.)

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8b3fe000304c47b585ce8062f888ec28&_e=EWPBZ_OYTtylN_Ip0GQ9Zxt4FynqrWrXvz2TCEcgWU23qE9iumNSQun_NDUZZJmrrtCNU6t4O5DSeyAO9SlYJTdFq2JCFLUUhQJQU1tDO5PobjEPm_Bnx23cYHdJyrEdLIBjCs_sm1NIFF7oaNpq4uG8oxME-R1KSWs4gRB1vxTogbEdu6LlzWEujJ5m9kqi3l5AY3XWiOGExACwqs-u_NRN6wgiAYsP_L_vE9QbIwglY-D4dFABQ16ealAfG50w3P0VLG1NyBqK5gQlhpYyhgFaliCSCo0faBEld3ZdDF9l8iR3oluM5HjlxOptIcD9tiU1bsnHcPpkGb-OiZyor2-nggKb79ssymaivWvQpRbLiElhoeNI_osb487Ivjc2)

Dear Friend, In recent years, there has been a noticeable shift among young Americans who increasingly favor socialism over capitalism. This trend raises a critical question: do they fully understand these two systems' historical contexts and real-world outcomes?

To address this, we have created a new eBook, **_The History of Socialism and Capitalism_** , authored by two of the most prominent voices in today's political discourse, Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This new eBook offers a deep dive into the origins, development, and impacts of socialism and capitalism. Each scholar presents an in-depth analysis through two different lenses. It's hard to overstate the relevance of this eBook in today's policy debates, where radical proposals are gaining traction.
| | Understanding the historical and practical implications of socialism and capitalism is crucial for making informed decisions about our economic and political future. The insights provided by Ferguson and Hanson will equip you with the knowledge to critically evaluate these competing ideologies and their potential impact on society.

Don't miss this opportunity to enhance your understanding of these pivotal economic systems. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

# [If House Republicans shut down the government, stop paying their salaries!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb7f41545-ef3d-451d-acdb-6b178707f74f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | With a government shutdown looming, Republican Speaker of the House Mike Johnson is demanding a funding bill that includes a series of steps _ to make it harder to vote_. Republicans know they can't win a fair election, so they are trying to put up impediments that suppress the vote of those more likely to be Democrats. It's un-American, it's un-democratic, and they're willing to shut down the government if they don't get their way. And not surprisingly, Donald Trump is demanding House Republicans do it, regardless of how much damage it does to the country. Trump's cronies in Congress are willing to wreak havoc just to score political points and do Trump's bidding. **Well, if they can't do their job – representing and working for the American people – they shouldn't be paid. Not one penny, for as long as it takes.** They want to inflict pain on the people? Then let them be the first ones to feel it. [**Sign your name: If House Republicans shut down the government, stop paying their salaries!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T13889b05-b348-49f9-9a91-e3b4cfa0b39b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

A police spokeswoman said just before 3 p.m. that the three were taken to hospitals, but their conditions were unknown. No information about the suspect was available, she said.

Police said officers responded about 12:15 p.m. to the 1800 block of Commerce Street, near South St. Paul Street. More than 20 police units responded to the shooting Thursday afternoon, according to an online police call log. Police at a news conference declined to take further questions, citing an active investigation.

Dallas Fire-Rescue also responded to the Continental building and sent multiple units, two of which took patients to hospitals, a spokesman said. Residents of the building told _The Dallas Morning News_ that they heard more than a dozen shots.

Three people were wounded in a shooting Thursday afternoon in downtown Dallas, police say." [DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/853469b4-412e-4984-84d3-675491b93a11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

**" Texas Children's Hospital's longtime CEO, Mark Wallace, retires,"** Houston Chronicle's**Julian Gill** -- "**Mark Wallace** , who served as the top executive at [Texas Children's Hospital](https://substack.com/redirect/a07728e8-e3bb-4b7f-b22d-0f397fb9a4b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for more than three decades, announced his retirement Thursday.

His last day is Oct. 4.

"I've spent a lot of time reflecting on when my last day would be since announcing the search for a new President last year," Wallace said in a news release. "I knew back then that my final chapter was beginning and I'm so happy with how everything has fallen into place. Now, as I embark on this new season-- one filled with more time with my wife and my family, friends and perhaps even a few new adventures -- I leave with a full heart and deep appreciation for my incredible team. I know that Texas Children's will only get better and better in the years to come and I will always be cheering this phenomenal organization on from wherever life takes me."

Wallace was the [longest serving chief executive](https://substack.com/redirect/86fd418b-444e-4481-b63b-e5f97eb105da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the medical center. He [took the helm in 1989](https://substack.com/redirect/ef352149-a26b-496c-a1d9-1c7a2833d423?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at 36 years old and saw the institution through a massive expansion throughout the Houston region, including Katy and The Woodlands. He also integrated women's health care with the opening of the Pavilion for Women in 2012. Texas Children's recently opened a hospital in Austin, where it plans to continue its expansion.

"After 35 years of dedicated service, Mark has not only led this hospital with unparalleled vision and integrity but has touched the lives of every single person who walked through these doors," **Park Shaper** , Chair of the Texas Children's Board of Trustees, said in the release. "His compassion, unwavering commitment and genuine care for our patients and staff have made this place more than a hospital and as we bid farewell, we are grateful to know that his legacy will continue to guide our every step."" [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/c7cde42d-d7b6-4605-ab2b-ea465be2c578?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

* **LOCAL GOVERNMENT**

**" Harris County Justice of the Peace issues blanket recall of all warrants,"** The Texan's**Holly Hansen** -- "A Harris County justice of the peace has recalled all warrants issued through his court, thwarting law enforcement efforts in his jurisdiction to enforce traffic laws, pursue fraudulent check writers, and detain individuals who had failed to appear in court.

Judge**Steve Duble** , justice of the peace for Harris County's Precinct 1, sent a letter on August 22, 2024, to staff working for Constable **Alan Rosen** notifying them that he had recalled the warrants.

"Please accept this official notification that after extensive research and thoughtful consideration, I have decided to recall each and every outstanding warrant issued from this court, Justice of the Peace Court, Precinct 1, Place 2," wrote Duble.

Duble noted that the recalled warrants included those for bad checks and capias warrants which require police to detain an individual until they appear in court. Warrants may also be issued to individuals who have failed to appear in court.

On Wednesday night, Duble released a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/30b8995d-4241-4a58-9979-d879f652271c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to explain his action. He wrote, "The recall was ordered to comply with the Constitution. Notwithstanding the recall, the court will promptly abide by and comply with instructions of any superior court of competent jurisdiction holding that this court's understanding of its constitutional obligations in this regard is mistaken."

Justice of the peace courts in Texas handle some civil matters and class C misdemeanors that are punishable by fine. Cases may include traffic violations, disorderly conduct, and misdemeanor assaults.

Texas law gives magistrates some authority to recall warrants, but Duble's blanket recall may conflict with the Texas [Criminal Code of Procedures](https://substack.com/redirect/cbbce1af-2078-40c8-839f-2dea58b3ad18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which states that "If an accused fails to appear as required by [an] order, the judge of the court in which the accused is required to appear shall issue a warrant for the arrest of the accused." The law also states that magistrates must issue warrants for suspects who fail to appear in court for certain [citations](https://substack.com/redirect/8f03ccb6-08bb-4ae1-b861-35561e590b9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Elected in 2022, Duble campaigned on establishing eviction diversion programs and promised to bring a "social justice lens" to his courtroom.

Duble did not return a request for comment by the time of publication.

The Harris County District Attorney's Office (HCDAO) told The Texan that they had only recently been made aware of the blanket warrant recall.

"We only recently were made aware of Judge Duble's inexplicable decision to grant fugitives a free pass in his courtroom," said an HCDAO spokesperson. "This decision can endanger the lives of the public and of our law-enforcement officers. Accountability is fundamental to justice, and without it, the public loses faith in our entire judicial system."

State Sen.**Paul Bettencourt** (R-Houston) told The Texan he thought a formal complaint should be made to the State Commission on Judicial Conduct (SCJC).

"There is no way this is a legitimate legal move by this JP that the public will believe or understand," said Bettencourt." [The Texan](https://substack.com/redirect/a2a33ad8-d5c1-455e-a589-313d8e21e641?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**" Gerald Goines trial: Ex-officer testifies sergeant may have had camera,"** Houston Chronicle's**Nicole Hensley** -- "Former Houston police officer **Steven Bryant's** testimony in the [Gerald Goines trial](https://substack.com/redirect/be320c1d-2f79-4f8d-8009-3a4bfe606cc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) came to a halt after he revealed a sergeant who participated in the Harding Street raid may have been wearing a personal body-worn camera, when up until now, it was believed there was no video inside the home.

Bryant, who pleaded guilty in 2021 to federal charges in connection with the raid, told jurors that former Sgt. **Clemente Reyna** had his own personal device, rather than a department-issued camera, that he would wear on raids. He assumed Reyna was wearing the device as the Squad 15 narcotics team stormed into the [Harding Street](https://substack.com/redirect/3d9b6f38-a8c7-4c7e-946d-12deb09e24c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) home of **Dennis Tuttle** and **Rhogena Nicholas** , who were shot and killed, according to his testimony.

The former officer said he did not see the camera but he based his assumption on a conversation he had with fellow officer **Felipe Gallegos** , who had told him Reyna had the camera. Gallegos was previously charged with felony murder as well, after the raid. Reyna, but not Gallegos, has been asked to testify, according to court records.

Reyna is charged with three counts of tampering with records and theft in connection with an alleged overtime scheme uncovered amid the Harding Street raid scandal.

The Chronicle reported in the raid's aftermath none of the narcotics officers who took part in the heroin bust had video from body cameras for investigators to examine. At the time, police management had yet to deploy recording devices among undercover units engaged in tactical operations.

Prosecutor **Tanisha Manning** ceased her questioning as Bryant disclosed the possibility that camera footage may exist of the disastrous raid that left two people dead and five police officers wounded. One of the officers, Goines, is on trial for two counts of felony murder in connection with the deaths. He is accused of killing the couple by lying about a confidential informant on the sworn no-knock warrant used to raid the couple's Pecan Park home.

Bryant's disclosure happened on the fourth day of testimony in Goines' trial." [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/f09de96d-f234-4582-bea3-843740ea254a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)
