| | Passed in 2021 after record turnout in 2020, SB 202 is still impacting how we vote in Georgia. Let’s break it down:
* SB 202 made a number of controversial changes to how elections are run in the state.
* Since it became law, it has served as the blueprint for voter suppression bills nationwide.
* SB 202 imposed burdensome voter ID requirements, criminalized handing out food and water to voters in line, and placed unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes.
* It also gave legislators the power to take over county Boards of Elections. Yes, you read that right, and kick the elected Georgia Secretary of State off of the State Election Board.
* And to top it all off, it made filing mass voter challenges even easier.

Thanks to SB 202, any Georgian can challenge an unlimited number of registered voters in their county, a tactic we’ve seen used to intimidate eligible voters from heading to the polls. [**SB 202 was designed to target and disenfranchise Black, brown, young, and unhoused voters. Your gift to Fair Fight Action helps us continue to monitor the impact of anti-voter legislation and fight to keep access to the ballot box free and fair for all. Chip in now to keep fighting back.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92748538/498167648/-1464299537?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20240912_f_impactsb202_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjA5ZmM3Yy1lOTcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2GaDF3sTS8qNd5hdap9FXrdmKQ8J_DccQWr_KfUGFY8=) In just three years, SB 202 has changed how we vote in Georgia, and the impact is glaring: in 2023 there was a major uptick in vote-by-mail application rejection rates, which raises alarms for this election season. Georgians lost 109 days of vote-by-mail, and lost five days on the tail end of the vote-by-mail schedule, against the recommendations of elections supervisors. This year, the legislature passed SB 189, a new anti-voter law that builds on SB 202 and makes it easier for conspiracy supporting vigilantes to challenge Georgia voters’ freedom to cast a ballot and potentially purge them from the voter rolls. This is a blatant attempt to reshape Georgia by marginalizing the voices and rights of its people. [**We must continue to fight back against anti-voter legislation in order to ensure our elections are fair and reflect the people — your donation today powers this work.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92748540/498167656/-1464299537?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20240912_f_impactsb202_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjA5ZmM3Yy1lOTcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2GaDF3sTS8qNd5hdap9FXrdmKQ8J_DccQWr_KfUGFY8=) Voter suppression has no place in our elections. Thank you for being part of this fight. Nicole Robinson

clean_body: Chip in now to protect access to the ballot box | | | Passed in 2021 after record turnout in 2020, SB 202 is still impacting how we vote in Georgia. Let’s break it down: SB 202 made a number of controversial changes to how elections are run in the state. Since it became law, it has served as the blueprint for voter suppression bills nationwide. SB 202 imposed burdensome voter ID requirements, criminalized handing out food and water to voters in line, and placed unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes. It also gave legislators the power to take over county Boards of Elections. Yes, you read that right, and kick the elected Georgia Secretary of State off of the State Election Board. And to top it all off, it made filing mass voter challenges even easier. Thanks to SB 202, any Georgian can challenge an unlimited number of registered voters in their county, a tactic we’ve seen used to intimidate eligible voters from heading to the polls. = In just three years, SB 202 has changed how we vote in Georgia, and the impact is glaring: in 2023 there was a major uptick in vote-by-mail application rejection rates, which raises alarms for this election season. Georgians lost 109 days of vote-by-mail, and lost five days on the tail end of the vote-by-mail schedule, against the recommendations of elections supervisors. This year, the legislature passed SB 189, a new anti-voter law that builds on SB 202 and makes it easier for conspiracy supporting vigilantes to challenge Georgia voters’ freedom to cast a ballot and potentially purge them from the voter rolls. This is a blatant attempt to reshape Georgia by marginalizing the voices and rights of its people. = Voter suppression has no place in our elections. Thank you for being part of this fight. subject: This is a BIG step toward breaking the lavender glass ceiling

body:
This is a historic moment — but the work’s not over.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240913&t=1&akid=1179%2E587540%2Enm_dTk)
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240913?refcode=em20240913&amount=5&refcode2=1179_587540_nm_dTk&akid=1179%2E587540%2Enm_dTk)**
Peter, I’m Sarah McBride.
In 2020, I defied the odds and became the first openly trans person elected to serve as a State Senator anywhere in the country.
**Now, I am the official Democratic nominee to represent Delaware in Congress.**
**We have a real shot of winning this race, finally shattering the national lavender glass ceiling, and electing the first openly trans member of Congress in its 235-year history — but only with your help.**
**[There are 8 weeks left in this election, and every single dollar makes a difference in the fight ahead: Be part of this historic moment by splitting a donation of $5 or more between Leaders We Deserve and my campaign right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240913?refcode=em20240913&amount=5&refcode2=1179_587540_nm_dTk&akid=1179%2E587540%2Enm_dTk)**
I’m so hopeful for the future right now, but I can’t ignore the present: This will make me even more of a target for far-right extremists.
Marjorie Taylor Greene has already called this campaign a “complete evil” that would “curse” the nation, but we turned those hurtful words into action and built a powerful, united, and joyful coalition.
While MAGA extremists will always be particularly weird when it comes to Americans like me, their inhumanity and attacks stand in direct contrast with my literal humanity and the trans community nationwide. **And right now, there is no transgender person in the U.S. House to stand up to them. YOU can change that.**
We can let their unhinged behavior contrast with my approach to the job — which is to roll up my sleeves, dive into the details, bring people together, and work to make historic progress on the issues we all care about: affordable health care and housing, abortion access, gun reform, and more.
**[That’s the work ahead, and that’s what I’m hoping you’ll invest in right now — we’re building the foundation to win on Election Day, and I want us to own this victory, together. Split a donation of $5 or more to become a founding donor right now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240913?refcode=em20240913&amount=5&refcode2=1179_587540_nm_dTk&akid=1179%2E587540%2Enm_dTk)**

Thank you,
Sarah McBride

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: A personal explanation
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Our September mid-month fundraising drive is particularly important. Here’s why:
#

Hi friends,
It’s Gabby. We’re launching a critical mid-month fundraising drive today, so I’m reaching out personally to ask you to contribute $3 to our work at GIFFORDS. But before I ask, I want to give you an explanation for why this is so important—especially right now.
When I dedicated my life’s work to making our communities safer from gun violence, my biggest fear was that we would come up short. I knew friends would help launch our effort, but we also needed significant grassroots support to prove that the American people were on our side.
I worried because the stakes are high. Lives are on the line. And it scared me because anything less than undeniable success would have been seen as a sign that there was no real support for change, and that would set us back even further.
But I took the leap of faith and put my trust in people like you. Now, look at where we are eleven years later. Hundreds of laws passed in nearly every state. The first federal gun safety legislation in over three decades is now law. Our work—together—has saved countless lives.
But the work is not done. Just like my road to recovery, there are still challenges ahead, and I need you by my side to overcome them.
Our September mid-month fundraising drive is particularly important because at the end of this month we will be facing our last quarterly FEC fundraising deadline before Election Day. This is one of our last chances to raise the resources we need to support our endorsed gun safety champions.
I really need you by my side to make sure we see success this November, and that means flipping the House, holding our razor-thin gun safety Senate majority, and electing Vice President Kamala Harris as our next president.
[**Now is the time to act. So please, can I count on you to make a donation to GIFFORDS PAC before our mid-month fundraising drive ends this Sunday?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240913-1-30&t=1&akid=8931%2E3935704%2EYaLH4p)

body:
After Harris’ stellar debate performance, NYT says undecided voters need more policy details to make a choice

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92751828/498179388/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzVhMzU3NmItZWQ3MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aG_WopywIMPsaIoAnpP0t-prUI1PyKiglCQR28uAvb0=&emci=3a4e316d-e571-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=35a3576b-ed71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
On the debate stage on Tuesday, Vice President Kamala Harris looked polished, prepared, and, most importantly, presidential. Trump, on the other hand, was an angry mess.
In viral moment after viral moment, Trump accused immigrants of eating pets in Ohio and showed he cared more about defending his crowd sizes than he did putting forth any serious policy ideas, including a laugh-out-loud moment where he said he had “concepts” of a health care plan to replace Obamacare.
**By any measure, Kamala Harris won the debate. So, how did _The New York Times_ react?**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92751831/498179391/-593472309?refcode=20240913-EM-postdebate3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzVhMzU3NmItZWQ3MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aG_WopywIMPsaIoAnpP0t-prUI1PyKiglCQR28uAvb0=)
[**We’ll talk about the legacy media’s toxic both-sides-ism in a moment, but if you support COURIER’s mission to call out bias in the media, can you chip in $25 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92751834/498179393/-593472309?refcode=20240913-EM-postdebate3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzVhMzU3NmItZWQ3MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aG_WopywIMPsaIoAnpP0t-prUI1PyKiglCQR28uAvb0=)
To appear “balanced,” legacy media outlets like _The New York Times_ have consistently pushed the right-wing talking point that Vice President Harris is all style and no substance – that she has no plans or policies.
**In the hours after the debate,_The New York Times_ doubled down on this idea in interviews with undecided voters. _The Times_ said those voters said they wanted more “fine print” from Harris. **
But here’s the problem with that conclusion.
Research consistently shows that undecided voters are less engaged with politics. Their policy views are often mixed with ideas from both parties, and in the end the idea that the “fine print” of a policy will be the thing that persuades an undecided voter is simply untrue.
**This is the danger of the outdated “both sides” framing of the legacy media.** You are forced to consider a blatantly false idea (here, the right-wing talking point that Kamala Harris lacks substance) and question what was so obvious at the debate – Donald Trump is unfit and unprepared to be President. No fine print needed.
Here at COURIER, we don’t engage with the false “both sides” argument. In fact, we call it out when we see it. Just take a look:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92751842/498179396/-593472309?refcode=20240913-EM-postdebate3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzVhMzU3NmItZWQ3MS1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aG_WopywIMPsaIoAnpP0t-prUI1PyKiglCQR28uAvb0=)
The legacy media’s unwillingness to call out Trump’s lack of fitness for office contributed to his victory in 2016. We can’t let that happen again. That’s why COURIER is doing our part to hold the media accountable for their biased reporting.
[**But we can’t do it without your help. clean_body: After Harris’ stellar debate performance, NYT says undecided voters need more policy details to make a choice Peter, On the debate stage on Tuesday, Vice President Kamala Harris looked polished, prepared, and, most importantly, presidential. Trump, on the other hand, was an angry mess. In viral moment after viral moment, Trump accused immigrants of eating pets in Ohio and showed he cared more about defending his crowd sizes than he did putting forth any serious policy ideas, including a laugh-out-loud moment where he said he had “concepts” of a health care plan to replace Obamacare. By any measure, Kamala Harris won the debate. So, how did The New York Times react? = = To appear “balanced,” legacy media outlets like The New York Times have consistently pushed the right-wing talking point that Vice President Harris is all style and no substance – that she has no plans or policies. In the hours after the debate,The New York Times doubled down on this idea in interviews with undecided voters. The Times said those voters said they wanted more “fine print” from Harris. But here’s the problem with that conclusion. Research consistently shows that undecided voters are less engaged with politics. Their policy views are often mixed with ideas from both parties, and in the end the idea that the “fine print” of a policy will be the thing that persuades an undecided voter is simply untrue. This is the danger of the outdated “both sides” framing of the legacy media. You are forced to consider a blatantly false idea (here, the right-wing talking point that Kamala Harris lacks substance) and question what was so obvious at the debate – Donald Trump is unfit and unprepared to be President. body:
| I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. _Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from Ruben Gallego. Ruben is running in Arizona to defend our Democratic majority, so I hope you'll read his message and[chip in if you can.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-gallego.sustuI&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240913_AM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=3656%2E35263%2EFF6x8U)_
* * *
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-gallego.sustuI&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240913_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=3656%2E35263%2EFF6x8U) Peter, Arizona is about 33% Latino. If I win my race, it’ll be the first time any of those people will see someone who looks like them representing our state in the U.S. Senate. I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. [**If you’ve got my back and are ready to make that happen, could you make a split donation of $10 with Tammy Baldwin to help us win this race?**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-gallego.JRYRxA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240913_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=3656%2E35263%2EFF6x8U) | | [CONTRIBUTE](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-gallego.JRYRxA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240913_AM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=3656%2E35263%2EFF6x8U)
---
Kids who grow up the way I did don’t make their way to the U.S. Senate. Statistically speaking, I never should’ve made it to college.
But thanks to my mom, my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard.
I served in the Marines, and I fought in Iraq.
I came back, and I got elected to Congress. I served almost 10 years, fighting for my people. And now, I’m taking on Kari Lake and the MAGA-right to defend Arizona and take back a critical seat in the U.S. Senate.
Talking heads have been telling us for months that this race would come down to the wire, and right now the polls are narrowing considerably. It’s a fight to the finish. What I need more than anything else is the resources to fight back against the waves of attacks and ads coming my way.
To win, I need you to join me in this fight. With you, we can do it. Without you, I don’t have a shot.
[**Please, can you afford to split $10 and help me become the first Latino Senator from Arizona? A Senator for ALL Arizonans, no matter what party they belong to or what country their family came from.**](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-gallego.JRYRxA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240913_AM1_V1_S1&t=7&akid=3656%2E35263%2EFF6x8U)

| | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. Donald Trump and JD Vance are inspiring terrorism in the United States. This is not hyperbole. Today we have breaking news that two elementary schools have been shut down and evacuated due to legitimate bomb threats inspired by Trump's anti-immigrant and anti-Haitian bigotry. [ABC News and The Hill report](https://substack.com/redirect/d9902d57-f282-43eb-96c2-4bf2719f5b37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> On Thursday, city hall [was evacuated](https://substack.com/redirect/4607d2c0-7084-4b5f-b8b2-05e46e87e842?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after a bomb threat was issued to "multiple facilities" in the area. Two elementary schools were also listed in the threat. It was later revealed the bomb threat [used hateful language](https://substack.com/redirect/6a07f8e3-ed66-46ce-94d3-9208f3510e60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the city's immigrant population. The threats come just days after Trump took the stage in Philadelphia at presidential debate and [gave voice to conspiracy theories](https://substack.com/redirect/5dcc95f5-1489-404f-b7ae-7debab5e0a48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that migrants, particularly Haitian migrants in Springfield, were eating people's cats and dogs.
Far from an isolated incident, this is part of Trump's decade long trend of inspiring terrorism in the United States. **Let 's Address This**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/241e7ec0-376a-4d2e-a335-443bcff5a948?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Known racists, JD Vance and Donald Trump. (AP Photo/Ben Gray, File)
**Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. Consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WdIuvCUimAhnqnMGr9hTWnYqaRaoFIdM9qrTDfSfmuY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=148855289)
If you saw the President debate between Donald Trump and Kamala Harris, then you likely saw this unhinged quote from the Republican nominee for President:
> In Springfield, they're eating the dogs, the people that came in, they're eating the cats. They're eating the pets of the people that live there.
Trump attributed this lie to Haitian immigrants, adding that they are "invading" Springfield, Ohio. He repeated this propaganda claim on Thursday September 12 at a campaign stop:
> There's a place called Springfield, Ohio, that you've been reading about. Twenty-thousand illegal Haitian immigrants have descended upon the town of 58,000 people, destroying their entire way of life. This was a beautiful community and now it's horrible what's happened.
JD Vance, who is married to the daughter of Indian immigrants, [defended and repeated Trump's vile and racist comments against Haitian immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/702d3fe6-7cd8-4571-b013-e3449e20adc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Meanwhile, everyone from the Springfield City Manager, to the Springfield Mayor, to Ohio's Republican Governor DeWine have all rejected this false attack on Haitian immigrants.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/85ee6029-dedd-4e2a-a52f-86eeea71a694?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
SEIU 1199 Vice President Gerard Cadet speaks at a press conference in support of Haitian immigrants. (WNV/Max Zahn)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WdIuvCUimAhnqnMGr9hTWnYqaRaoFIdM9qrTDfSfmuY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148855289)
Trump's anti-Haitian hate is even more perplexing given that he [extended TPS status for 59,000 Haitian immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/623e2a5b-7207-409d-bc4e-0537a2755db7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But somehow his racism shines through uninhibited. Unsurprisingly, Trump's claim that Haitian immigrants are hurting the economy is a flat out lie. Jamie McGregor is the CEO of McGregor Metal, which makes welded parts for the auto and farm industries, [and says this about his immigrant Haitian employees](https://substack.com/redirect/04583d12-449f-4259-9f53-f8dd6c195e8c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> I wish I had 30 more. Our Haitian associates come to work every day. They don't have a drug problem. They will stay at their machine. They will achieve their numbers. They are here to work. And so, in general, that's a stark difference from what we're used to in our community.
Springfield residents go on to point out that their church pews are full for the first time in a long time, because Haitians are observant and practicing Christians. As Trump denounces devout Black Haitian Christians, a reminder that when he claims Christianity is being attacked what he actually means is his white supremacy is being attacked.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/16cf1472-b949-400e-ab55-5a7fc0677dd7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And speaking of attacks, Trump's aforementioned incitement to terrorism is not new. An ABC News study from 2020 found that [Trump's violent rhetoric ignited actual violence at least 54 times](https://substack.com/redirect/8c4e9854-38e0-4493-ae00-267ba5522670?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> A nationwide review conducted by ABC News has identified at least 54 criminal cases where Trump was invoked in direct connection with violent acts, threats of violence or allegations of assault. ABC News found that in at least 12 cases perpetrators hailed Trump in the midst or immediate aftermath of physically assaulting innocent victims. In another 18 cases, perpetrators cheered or defended Trump while taunting or threatening others. And in another 10 cases, Trump and his rhetoric were cited in court to explain a defendant's violent or threatening behavior.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WdIuvCUimAhnqnMGr9hTWnYqaRaoFIdM9qrTDfSfmuY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148855289)
By contrast, "ABC News could not find a single criminal case filed in federal or state court where an act of violence or threat was made in the name of President Barack Obama or President George W. Bush." Demonstrating once more that this is not a Republican vs Democrat issue, but a weird extremism vs normal American issue.
So what does all this mean for us?
In any normal election year, Vance and Trump inciting terrorism against Americans would be an automatic disqualification, and would likely earn criminal charges. Sadly, we do not live in normal times. But that is why it is that much more imperative we recognize these incitements to terrorism for the terrorism they are. We cannot become numb or calloused to these calls for violence, which are themselves grounded in white supremacy and anti-immigrant hate. Donald Trump has a documented record of inciting violence and terrorism against Americans--and his anti-Haitian rhetoric is just another example of his depravity for humanity, justice, and the rule of law. All Americans must stand united to reject it, unequivocally, once and for all.

An ABC News study from 2020 found that : A nationwide review conducted by ABC News has identified at least 54 criminal cases where Trump was invoked in direct connection with violent acts, threats of violence or allegations of assault. ABC News found that in at least 12 cases perpetrators hailed Trump in the midst or immediate aftermath of physically assaulting innocent victims. In another 18 cases, perpetrators cheered or defended Trump while taunting or threatening others. And in another 10 cases, Trump and his rhetoric were cited in court to explain a defendant's violent or threatening behavior. By contrast, "ABC News could not find a single criminal case filed in federal or state court where an act of violence or threat was made in the name of President Barack Obama or President George W. Bush." Demonstrating once more that this is not a Republican vs Democrat issue, but a weird extremism vs normal American issue. So what does all this mean for us? In any normal election year, Vance and Trump inciting terrorism against Americans would be an automatic disqualification, and would likely earn criminal charges. Sadly, we do not live in normal times. But that is why it is that much more imperative we recognize these incitements to terrorism for the terrorism they are. We cannot become numb or calloused to these calls for violence, which are themselves grounded in white supremacy and anti-immigrant hate. Donald Trump has a documented record of inciting violence and terrorism against Americans--and his anti-Haitian rhetoric is just another example of his depravity for humanity, justice, and the rule of law. All Americans must stand united to reject it, unequivocally, once and for all. Why Your Support Matters:** Every dollar we spend is a vote for the kind of future we want. Join Me
Dear Peter,
Everyone has heard President Trump’s signature phrase, Drain the Swamp. His instinct is spot on. The problem in Washington isn’t just a few corrupt individuals. _It is a whole corrupt system._
**It’s the federal agencies. It’s the lobbyists. It’s the research organizations, it’s the media, and it’s the corporations.**
Well, I’ve spent 40 years suing almost all of them. In many of these agencies, I know the names of the bad actors who need to be moved out. I understand the perverse incentives that put agency capture on steroids.
I know how the system is supposed to work to protect the public interest and how it actually works to protect the mercantile interests of the regulated industries that have captured it. **AND I know how to fix it**. And that is exactly what I am going to do with Donald Trump’s backing.
Let me tell you what we are going to do
**We are going to:**
* **Appoint** honest officials who don’t have conflicts of interest.

* **Slam shut** the revolving door that sends industry executives and lobbyists in and out of government.
* **Fire** anyone who betrays the public trust or lies to the public.

**That’s what it means to drain the swamp.**
One of my top priorities in Washington will be to make sure President Trump can follow through on his promise and return us to a government OF THE PEOPLE.

subject: The possible outcomes this November
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
There are a few different possible outcomes this November.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240913-4286-footer&t=1&akid=4286%2E420207%2E7Yfbx9)
Peter,
There are a few different possible outcomes this November. Donald Trump could win the White House, or he could lose but Republicans could retain control of one or both chambers of Congress. In either case, we’ll have very little hope of implementing any major piece of our progressive agenda.
But there’s another scenario too. One where Kamala Harris and Tim Walz defeat Donald Trump and JD Vance, and Democrats flip the House while holding the Senate. **_That’s_ what we’re working toward.**
**[Pitch in to make it happen →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240913?amount=3&refcode=em20240913-4286&refcode2=4286_420207_7Yfbx9&akid=4286%2E420207%2E7Yfbx9)**
If we take back Congress _and_ win the White House, there are so many possibilities. All of a sudden, we’d have a Congress willing to make real progress on so many issues — and a president who’s willing to sign those bills into law.
* **We’ll be able to restore _Roe v. Wade_** and stop MAGA Republicans’ abortion bans.

* **We’ll be able to finally pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act** to protect our democracy and empower voters everywhere.

* **We’ll be able to pass real gun reform** like red flag laws, universal background checks, and a ban on assault weapons.

* **We’ll be able to make housing more affordable** and bring down costs for families in Washington and across the country.

* **We’ll be able to make meaningful progress toward Medicare For All** as we fix the Affordable Care Act and make healthcare more affordable.

And that’s just the start of it. But Peter, we can only do these things if we win the White House _and_ Congress this November. And regardless of what sensationalist headlines might have you think, the presidential race is still extremely close.
[**That’s why we’re reaching out to ask for your help. Peter, will you split a $3 donation between the Harris-Walz campaign and Pramila’s today to help us put our plans into action?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240913?refcode=em20240913&amount=3&refcode2=4286_420207_7Yfbx9&akid=4286%2E420207%2E7Yfbx9)

Peter,
We have some exciting ballot access updates. First, we got the news this morning that we WILL be on the ballot in Georgia. The Secretary of State wrote a letter this morning confirming that we qualified - we beat another of the anti-democratic party’s attempts to kick Jill and Butch off the ballot!! The bad news is that a few days ago we had an update about Nevada, where the anti-democratic party is attempting yet again to undermine democracy by using all the dirty tricks they can. To summarize, in case you missed it, the Nevada Secretary of State, a Democrat, gave the campaign the wrong forms to use to get on the ballot. Then the dirty Dems used that technicality to sue us off the ballot - we won in lower courts, only to lose in the Nevada Supreme Court. Not surprisingly, our research team found that the Chief Justice in the case is a DNC donor. But we aren’t quitting our fight for ballot access in Nevada so millions of people in the silver state can have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action option in November. **_Our lawyers are filing a case to take the fight to the highest court in the land: US Supreme Court._** This is good news for ballot access across the country. Our campaign had planned to tackle the unfair signature and fee requirements that vary wildly state-by-state, but we hadn’t planned to be able to do so in the Supreme Court so soon. Depending on the outcome, this could mean Greens all over the country will be able to run for office more easily and could save millions in 2028\. We can’t miss the opportunity to rectify this waste of time and resources. Jill and Butch need you to pitch in today to take this fight to the US Supreme Court and pay our legal fees in Nevada. Democrats are in BIG trouble
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92757362/498198031/-91377461?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4729-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmUxZWY3ZC1mNjcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QFNP0cvfcxHLVtthuNoRb6uSJfhwQsTD76s8UCQ1QzU=)
Folks – it’s James Carville.
I’ll tell it like it is: Democrats are in BIG trouble.
I’ve been in politics for a long time, and you’d be hard-pressed to find a map as tough as ours this year. We’re defending the most delicate Senate majority I’ve ever seen – and Mitch McConnell and his extremist cronies are bound to use every trick up their sleeves to snatch back control.
**The GOP is coming at us with full force, and they’re going ALL IN on Nevada as a top target – because they know this battleground is key to Senate control. ****But with Trump campaigning in Nevada in a few hours, a group of donors is TRIPLE-MATCHING all donations to Jacky's campaign today – giving us an opportunity we CAN'T miss to fight back.**
**[Nevada is a must-win seat to protect the Senate again in 2024, but Jacky is falling behind today's crucial fundraising goal, so can you please chip in $5 ASAP?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92757363/498198032/-91377461?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4729-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZmUxZWY3ZC1mNjcxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QFNP0cvfcxHLVtthuNoRb6uSJfhwQsTD76s8UCQ1QzU=)**

Democrats barely won in the Silver State by a slim 7,928 votes last election, the closest Senate race in the country – **so you can bet that Mitch McConnell and his far-right posse have a bone to pick.** They have a massive, dark money war chest behind them and are pouring millions and millions of dollars into attacking Jacky's reputation.

body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/9ZdEKKdehECfx0NYWScfHQ2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/9ZdEKKdehECfx0NYWScfHQ2]
Dear Peter,
Climate chaos is hitting our planet hard, and the consequences can be seen everywhere. Places across the country reached record-breaking high temperatures–some even breaking multiple records just this summer alone–and Oregon was no exception. These extreme temperatures are threatening not just keystone species like native bees, but also our forests, farms, and fisheries, putting lives and livelihoods at risk.
We’re taking bold steps to address the devastating effects of climate impacts at the state level, but it won’t be enough unless the entire country is in this together. That’s why it’s so important to support new opportunities for clean energy, jobs, justice, and nature conservation that are currently moving at the national level. Learn more about the ongoing fight for climate action and environmental protections in D.C. at our upcoming virtual town hall with Senator Jeff Merkley.
Save the date for OLCV's Virtual Town Hall on the Environment with Senator Jeff Merkley! [https://secure.everyaction.com/9ZdEKKdehECfx0NYWScfHQ2?contactdata=dzKcGYz9IGdUkL1U1MpGgwf+H2aZEiA1vbHRpsX29nLRx//4IySeVpYxYv4ad4dtukoCevMgihCAUfuM3ZEZhbl2rp1pKi9woq994mIakJR7eYhw2lrr0xIIcMU74+SO&quick=true]
WHEN: Tuesday, October 8th, exact time TBD. Mark your calendars today!
WHERE: Zoom webinar (link will be shared a few days before the town hall)
Senator Merkley is a climate and environmental champion. He strongly supported and worked to pass the 2021 Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and Inflation Reduction Act, which made historic investments to help address the climate crisis and make progress on environmental justice. Last year, he introduced the Pollinator Power Act to help reverse the decline in pollinator populations.
On October 8, Senator Merkley will update us on what he is working on now, talk to us about how the climate investments of the IRA will benefit Oregon, and answer selected audience questions
Hope to see you there,
Lindsey Scholten

After launching this campaign over a year ago, we are just one step closer to bringing our **Bright Hope** mission to the U.S. Senate. I truly could not have done it without your grassroots support bringing us together at this moment.

**But we know that the real race starts right now.**

We know that my self-funding opponent will write blank checks to keep their campaign afloat. And our people-powered movement continues to be attacked by far-right activists — from Ben Shapiro to even Donald Trump’s campaign.

Team,
**It’s Friday the 13th – but the real horror isn’t some old movie.** The real nightmare is unfolding in Congress, where Republicans are slashing our rights, blocking progress, and filling the courts with extremists. If we don’t act fast, they’ll continue their attack on everything we hold dear.
Right now, we’re at a turning point. We have one chance to stop this: elect more Democrats to the Senate, House, and the White House. But here’s the truth – **_we’re up against millions from right-wing Super PACs and billionaires who are determined to buy this election_**.
We don’t have their money, but we’ve got something they can’t match: you.
Your grassroots support is our secret weapon. Together, we can flip seats, protect our democracy, and restore sanity in Washington. But we need everyone to step up – and that includes you, team.

Vox - Project 2025: The myths and the facts [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091324_2&amount=25]
There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Are you ready to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091324_2&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.
Fuel our efforts to spread the word and educate voters about these dangerous plans with $25 or more today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091324_2&amount=25]

[**This is the dangerous extremism we’re up against right now in Delaware and across the country, and we can’t take any race for granted this year. ---
| | | **Stop the Rising Costs and Fight Against Misguided Electric Car Mandates**
---

Dear Peter,
As gas prices continue to rise, hardworking families in Washington's 8th Congressional District are feeling the squeeze. Kim Schrier claims to support our families and fight for them. Yet gas prices continue to rise due to an effort by Kim and others to force families to buy electric cars and cut us off from fossil fuels.
Where’s the consideration for those families that can’t afford an electric vehicle or the electric bill to charge that electric car? Why doesn’t Kim Schrier care about all of our families?
We need policies that lower gas prices, support energy independence, and give families the freedom to choose what’s best for them—not government mandates that drive up costs and limit our options.

---
| | | |
---
| Our campaign is committed to fighting these misguided policies and advocating for common-sense solutions that put people first. But we can’t do it alone—we need your support.
Your donation will help us stand up to the out-of-touch politicians pushing these costly mandates and ensure that our district has a voice in the fight for affordable energy and freedom of choice. Whether it’s $20, $50, or any amount, your contribution is crucial.

---

Message: To Gen Z Republicans

Long Form Message for long social posts or for print

Hey Gen Z! This election isn’t just another chance to vote—it’s an opportunity to shape your future. By voting early, you’re taking control of your voice and giving yourself the best shot at making sure your vote is counted without last-minute stress.

The American Dream is alive and evolving, and it’s up to you to decide how it looks. By voting early, you’re ensuring that your generation's values of freedom, opportunity, and meritocracy are protected. Your vote helps ensure that the country continues to provide opportunities for success, hard work, and innovation.

Don’t wait for election day to make a difference—secure your voice, secure your future, and protect the American Dream. Vote early, vote for your future.

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

Hey, Gen Z! This election is your chance to shape the future. Vote early to make sure your voice is heard and stress-free. Protect freedom, opportunity, and the American Dream. Don’t wait—vote early and secure your future!

** Message: It’s Important to get All Republicans to the Polls:
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for long social posts or for print

We understand the sentiment surrounding voting by mail and the preference for showing up on Election Day—it’s part of the tradition for many Republicans. But we have to face the reality: times have changed, and we need to embrace every tool available to us. If we don’t, the Democrats will, and we’ll be left behind.

While Election Day voting remains essential, we can’t afford to overlook absentee voting or early voting. These options are attractive to a lot of people and allow us to secure votes well ahead of the rush. The truth is, the more we focus on voting early, the better chance we have of turning out Republican voters and ensuring our voices are heard.

It’s time to focus on encouraging people to vote early and vote Republican. Doing so will increase turnout and give us the strategic advantage we need to win. Let’s embrace the future and use every opportunity to strengthen our movement!

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

Republicans love Election Day, but times have changed. We must embrace early and absentee voting to stay competitive. If we don’t, Democrats will—and we’ll be left behind. Let’s focus on voting early to secure our voices and strengthen our movement. Vote early, vote Republican!

** Message: You are a reliable voter; vote early and bank the
------------------------------------------------------------

** vote (Hard Republican)
------------------------------------------------------------

**
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for Social posts or for print

Your consistent participation as a reliable voter is essential to shaping the direction of our nation. By voting early, you’re securing your vote and helping the party concentrate resources on those who have yet to cast their ballot.

When you ‘bank’ your vote early, you free up valuable time and effort for the party to focus on turning out less reliable voters. It’s a strategic move that maximizes the effectiveness of every vote and strengthens our chances of success. Early voting is how to lock in your support and let the team rally the rest.

Help us build momentum and stay ahead—vote early, bank your vote, and empower the party to bring more voters to the polls. Your early vote is key to securing victory!

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

As a reliable voter, voting early secures your vote and helps the party focus on turning out others. By banking your vote, you free up resources and strengthen our chances of success. Vote early and empower the team to win!

** Message: You are an older voter; vote early and bank the vote
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for Social posts or for print

As grandparents and pillars of your family, your vote isn’t just about today—it’s about the legacy you leave for your children and grandchildren. Voting early ensures that your voice is heard and your vote is counted without the worry of last-minute complications that could prevent you from making it to the polls.

Life can be unpredictable, especially as election day approaches. Voting early gives you the peace of mind that your contribution to the future is secure, no matter what. By casting your ballot ahead of time, you’re ensuring that your values, vision for a strong America, and commitment to the next generation will be counted.

Don’t wait until the last minute. Vote early, protect your vote, and secure your legacy for those you love.

Abbreviated for Text-based messaging / Robocalls

As grandparents and elder community members, your vote is about your legacy. Voting early ensures your voice is heard without last-minute worries. Secure your future and values by voting early and protecting what matters to your family!

** Message: Low Propensity (Weak) Republicans
------------------------------------------------------------

Long Form Message for Social posts or for print

Your voice matters—and voting is the only way to ensure it’s heard. By voting early, you guarantee that your vote counts without the risk of waiting until the last minute when things can come up. Life gets busy, but casting your vote early ensures that your voice is counted, no matter what.

This election is your chance to shape the future. Don’t leave it to chance—voting early is the easiest way to make sure your voice is part of the conversation. Be counted, make your vote matter, and help build the future you want to see.

Vote early to make sure it’s counted without last-minute issues. Don’t leave it to chance—vote early and help shape the future you want to see! Nothing changes if you stay home!

subject: Sherrod Brown
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
There is no holding on to the Senate for Democrats if Sherrod Brown loses this race. Period.

Friends —
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a donation directly to Sherrod Brown's campaign for U.S. Senate in Ohio. But first, you deserve to know why this request is so important.
Here's the truth:
There is no holding on to the Senate for Democrats if Sherrod Brown loses this race. Period.
Republicans know that as well. That is why right-wing outside groups are badly outspending Democrats in Ohio. Sherrod is getting absolutely hammered with negative ad after negative ad and we are pretty much in last-ditch mode to help him fight back.
Sherrod raises most of his money from individual, small-dollar donations. And he reached out to ask if we could help. Given the importance of this race I said yes.

Team, My mission as your mayor is to urgently move Los Angeles in a new direction — especially when it comes to the homelessness crisis. We have much more work ahead of us, but I wanted to make sure you saw the big news about our work so far: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92763448/498218779/1526939395?refcode=AU_KRB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_202408_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZDhlOTViZC0wMjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V5AUwqhDIQSxkzI54mkYMCztsKaU_bmyNFpDM3TXuOI=&emci=f18b8e23-6a48-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2d8e95bd-0272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=2429742) From declaring a state of emergency to accelerating the construction of affordable housing, we are changing how L.A. brings people inside and saves lives. Together, with locked arms, we’ve brought thousands more people inside last year than the year before. Here are some of the key takeaways from the 2024 Greater Los Angeles Homeless Count:
* Street homelessness is down 10% — the biggest decrease in the last 9 years
* The presence of makeshift shelters built on the side of the street is down 38%
* The number of people moved into shelter rose by 12.7%
* The number of Angelenos who moved into permanent housing is at an all-time high

subject: Urgent: Help Us Protect Alaska and America’s Future
body:
Help Us Protect Alaska and America’s Future. We have just 52 days before the election, and early voting starts soon. | | |
---
| | Dear Friend, I hope this message finds you well. Last month, I reached out on behalf of [Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92763471/498218889/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDQzYjdkMi0wMjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_dT6C2uI-KdWhC4WnGZy0yNlxK4iCzFIdi6LxLZGCgY=&emci=c6d486b5-ea71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=9043b7d2-0272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9512399) (BAF Action), a nonprofit committed to promoting democracy, transparency, and balanced politics. Today, I’m following up with an urgent and time-sensitive request. We have just 52 days before the election, and early voting starts soon. Mary Peltola, the first Alaska Native member of Congress, is facing Nick Begich III a Trump-aligned opponent in what will be a tough re-election. _Securing her seat is critical—not only for Alaska but for the entire country._ With Mary in Congress, we’re one seat closer to a Democratic majority, building a blue firewall to protect America from Project 2025, an extremist far-right agenda that could reshape our nation in dangerous ways. Project 2025 would:
* Use an 1870s law to limit abortion access nationwide
* Eliminate the Department of Education
* Force federal agencies to enforce a ‘biblically based’ definition of marriage and family
* Introduce a new national sales tax, costing the average family $2,500 per year
* Slash critical programs like Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.

This agenda would be disastrous for Alaska and the country as a whole. _To combat it, Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund is dedicated to transparency, education, and protecting Alaska’s legacy of bipartisanship._ Mary Peltola stands for the same values, working across party lines for solutions that benefit all Alaskans. We need your immediate support to raise funds for a hyper-targeted digital ad campaign that will get Mary’s message out to voters. Every dollar counts. [Can we count on you to donate today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92763472/498218890/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDQzYjdkMi0wMjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_dT6C2uI-KdWhC4WnGZy0yNlxK4iCzFIdi6LxLZGCgY=&emci=c6d486b5-ea71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=9043b7d2-0272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9512399) _Your contribution is essential in making sure we have the resources to fight back against extremist agendas like Project 2025 and to support leaders like Mary, who put Alaska first._ Every donation, no matter the amount, brings us one step closer to securing a better future for Alaska and America. Please don’t wait—[we need your support now to ensure Mary has the resources she needs to win.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92763473/498218891/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDQzYjdkMi0wMjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_dT6C2uI-KdWhC4WnGZy0yNlxK4iCzFIdi6LxLZGCgY=&emci=c6d486b5-ea71-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=9043b7d2-0272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9512399) I know you are being asked to contribute to many important races, and if you are like me, you may be over your campaign budget for the year. But consider this: more than any other race in Alaska this year, Mary’s is an opportunity for Alaska to make a significant positive contribution to a productive Congress and protect our nation against an extremist takeover in DC. Thank you for your continued commitment to Alaska’s future. Let’s make sure Mary stays in Congress to fight for our state and against extremism. Sincerely, Fran UlmerFormer Lt. Governor of Alaska Steering Committee Member of Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund

Friend, it's Team Sara reaching out. Happy Friday the 13th!

What's the scariest thing that Wisconsin Republicans have done?
We certainly know that there are plenty of options to choose from.

🤔When they stood behind Donald Trump after his 34 felony convictions, election denial, and his role in the January 6 insurrection?

We're not sure—that's why Sara wants to hear from you!

Team Sara Rodriguez
Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband.

Lt. Gov. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products.

She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company.

body:
Arizona is on a knife edge right now, and it’s beginning to tip away from us.
#

Hi, Peter — please, please, please... don’t scroll away right now. We need you to read this. We’re getting extremely nervous about Arizona.
Public polling shows our lead evaporating. Ruben led Kari Lake by as much as double digits as much as a few weeks ago, but the most recent rounds of polling have our race narrowing considerably and Trump holding a commanding lead.
**A statistical tie gives us no margin for error. Arizona is on a knife edge right now, and it is beginning to tip away from us.**[**Can you make a donation of $5 or whatever you can right now to help Ruben gain some ground on our FEC deadline goals and help us defend must-win Arizona?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-sept24.kTsNbj&refcode=em240913-3-160&t=1&akid=3077%2E734936%2Esc03BC)
Trump’s over the moon with this news. So is Kari Lake. Last time Trump was on the ballot in Arizona he lost by just 10,000 votes. In Kari Lake’s last election she did a little bit better — she only lost by about 17,000 votes. They can win a close election here. The risk is very, very real, and the consequences would be catastrophic.
There is no victory in the Electoral College without Arizona. We will not have a majority in the Senate if we lose Arizona. We can’t slack off. Not this late in the cycle.

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: I won't back down
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR SECRETARY OF STATE
body:
Friends,
This week I was in Washington to testify before the US House of Representatives about our elections. I wanted to talk about how election workers around the country are facing unprecedented threats and personal danger for simply trying to do our jobs with integrity and pride.
I made clear in my opening statement that we cannot have a secure democracy without securing the people who administer elections. And I talked about all the steps we are taking to ensure our voter registration database is accurate and our election operations are transparent, safe, fair and accessible.
Then things took a turn.
Instead of delving into these real challenges and needs for our elections, many of the GOP members of Congress on the committee began questioning why I was partnering with the Small Business Administration and the Department of Veterans Affairs to provide nonpartisan voter registration information to small business owners and veterans.
Yes, you read that right.
Here’s the deal: I will never apologize for doing everything I can to make sure every eligible citizen is registered to vote. And I’m proud of our nation-leading partnerships with the National Football League, the NBA, NASCAR, and yes, the Small Business Administration and Veterans Affairs agencies, to meet people where they are and give everyone - Republicans, Democrats and independents - nonpartisan information to enable their participation in our elections.
https://www.instagram.com/reel/C_yTjaPyPnD/?igsh=MW5jM3F4MzR1enVoaQ&nvep=&hmac=&emci=41ba9c12-f171-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.instagram.com/reel/C_yTjaPyPnD/?igsh=MW5jM3F4MzR1enVoaQ&nvep=&hmac=&emci=41ba9c12-f171-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
You and I both know that all eyes are going to be on Michigan once again this fall. We are ready for the spotlight and even the unrelenting scrutiny. We will continue to meet the moment and engage voters all across our state as we prepare for a historic election.
Because ensuring voting access for all eligible citizens is the lifeblood of our democracy. It's essential. And when it comes to meeting people where they are and getting them trusted information about our elections processes: I won’t back down.
If you agree - if you're with me - please add your name to our pledge stand with election workers throughout this historic message. Let’s send a strong message: We believe in democracy. And we won’t back down. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/7HOOKOVBw0a2hjG0hXSmZg2]
Onward!
-Jocelyn
PS: Please follow me on Instagram @JocelynBenson [https://www.instagram.com/jocelynbenson?igsh=MTgybDdtYW83MWNoaA==] ! I post regular updates there about all the things you can do to help us defend democracy in 2024 and beyond. We work hard to make sure we respect your inboxes – so head over to Instagram for more frequent updates as we head into the 2024 election cycle, and beyond.

body:
Hi friends,
This is Tim Kaine and Jacky Rosen here, and we’re reaching out today about two things that are really important to us — our faith, and our shared fight to continue serving the people of Virginia and Nevada in November.
This email is meaningful to us, and we hope you’ll take a moment to read it. B ut in case you’re pressed for time, we’d like to ask if you could split a donation to help power our campaigns in the weeks ahead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]
We come from different ideological backgrounds — Tim is Catholic, and Jacky is Jewish — but what unites us across our traditions is our shared belief in justice, compassion, and the importance of serving others.
Faith has always been a guiding force in our lives — for Tim, running a Jesuit mission school in Honduras teaching teenagers to be carpenters and welders, which shaped his work to combat poverty and create just systems in society. And for Jacky, the Jewish concept of tikkun olam – which means to leave the world a better place than we found it — guided her actions as President of her Synagogle and her decision to run for public office in the first place.
It’s important to share what grounds us. Like so many of you, our faith has taught us that we all have a responsibility to look out for our neighbors and to keep fighting against injustice and inequality whenever possible.
Right now, we’re in a tough fight — not just for our seats in the Senate, but for the values that shape our work every day.
The stakes couldn’t be higher — from safeguarding freedoms like reproductive rights and voting rights, to protecting our democracy from our MAGA opponents, to continuing to build an economy that works fairly for all Americans.
To accomplish these goals and so many more, we need to come together to hold onto our Democratic majority in the Senate. The good news is that what unites us is so much more powerful than what divides us — so we’ve got a real shot at getting this done.
Today, will you split a donation between our two campaigns so we can continue fighting for our shared values and the people of Virginia and Nevada in the U.S. Senate? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]

–Tim Kaine and Jacky Rosen

_**Mike Braun's Agriculture and Rural Plan for Indiana**_
---
---
Below are highlights from the Freedom and Opportunity Agenda - Agriculture and Rural Plan For Indiana.
---
**1) Improve Customer Service for Farmers**
* Establish a one-stop online portal to simplify access to funding, market opportunities, technical support, and regulatory updates—ensuring Hoosier farmers get the help they need quickly and efficiently.

**2) Tax Relief that Protects Family Farms**
* Provide historic property tax relief by capping annual increases, fixing the referendum process, and modernizing how farmland is valued to reflect the realities of today’s farm economy.

**3) Target Economic Development to Rural Communities**
* Ensure economic development dollars flow to rural communities with full transparency and accountability, so that small towns can grow and thrive.

**4) Build Out Reliable Connectivity**
* Introduce a matching grant program for broadband expansion to ensure every Hoosier, no matter where they live, has access to high-speed internet—a necessity for both families and modern agriculture.

**5) Protect Hoosier Farmland**
* Protect Indiana’s farmland from foreign adversaries by enforcing divestment rules, increasing transparency, and working with the General Assembly to monitor emerging threats.

---
**Mike Braun issued the following statement upon releasing his Agriculture and Rural Plan For Indiana:**
_"Hoosier family farms feed the world with millions of acres of crops, livestock, and poultry, and as governor, I will protect our farms while giving rural communities the tools they need to grow and thrive." - Mike Braun_

subject: The time for women to lead is now!
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Let’s get one thing straight: Hell yes, we’re ready for women to lead!
We don’t need permission. We need people to show up and do the work alongside us.
This race is the most important congressional race in the country. Jim Jordan is a rapid ideologue who exists only to protect Donald Trump and maintain his own power.
The latest polling shows me statistically tied with Jordan – but polls don’t vote, people do. And we need people to turn out in droves to take down the most dangerous man in Congress.
We’re aiming to raise $1 million this month to take back the House and send Jim Jordan packing. Every dollar you contribute brings us closer to that goal, fueling the ads, outreach, and ground game we need to win. Contribute today and help us hit this milestone. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240913_ready_to_lead_link1]
I’ve spent my entire life in Ohio, working for this community, and I’ve seen firsthand the strength and resilience of working families.
I know the challenges we face, and I know what it takes to lead.
Like so many women, I’ve been underestimated, dismissed, and judged simply because of my gender.
Well, I’m here to tell you—I’m ready to lead, and so are the millions of women across this country who are tired of being overlooked.
The ULTRA-MAGA extremists like Jim Jordan are terrified of women in power because they know we’ll hold them accountable for their attacks on our freedoms.
Jordan has spent his career rolling back women’s rights, but we’re fighting back.
Together, we will win in November. We can make it happen and defeat the MAGA war on women once and for all.
Let’s make history together. Chip in now to help us reach our goal, win this race, and prove that women are more than ready to lead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240913_ready_to_lead_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Peter,
After Missouri’s primary election last month, something started to shift in the U.S. Senate race between Josh Hawley and Marine veteran Lucas Kunce.
Hawley suddenly started attacking Lucas by name with a rant of lies — in his stump speech, on Twitter, on Fox News — anywhere he could. **_And then, less than 48 hours after Lucas officially won the nomination, Hawley’s campaign started spending millions of dollars to air false attacks about Lucas in their very first TV ads._**
**[FIGHT BACK: CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71531?refcode=em20240913-7650&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7650%2E614464%2EciNcq2)**
You and me of course always knew Lucas, his message, and our people-powered coalition were a threat to Hawley. But this just isn’t how an incumbent — let alone an incumbent in a “red” state — usually handles a challenger.
But it seems that like us, Hawley and his allies have tuned out the pundits and recognized reality: That they should be afraid of Lucas and his movement.
So in the last month, Hawley spent nearly THREE MILLION DOLLARS on FOUR FALSE ATTACK ADS. Meanwhile, our ads have been focused on Lucas, his record of service, and his commitment to restoring our freedoms and investing in Missouri.
**And now just a month after both sides started TV ads, this poll shows our race has gone from double-digits to only a four-point gap.**
In campaigns, that’s what we call “movement”. It’s what happens when millions of voters start seeing TV ads and learn about the candidates and their messages. And despite Hawley’s lies, it’s clear our message is breaking through and setting us on a path to win this race.
But Hawley’s campaign must have seen the same thing in their own numbers...because now out of nowhere, a **billionaire-backed Super PAC has just placed ONE MILLION DOLLARS in ads against Lucas to start THIS WEEKEND.**
**So we’re asking:[Will you rush a donation of $10, $25, or just whatever you can today so we’ll have the resources to continue getting Lucas and his message in front of Missouri voters? Please join Jeremy Scahill, Sharif Abdel Kouddous, and Laila Al-Arian at **8 p.m. ET, on Tuesday, September 17th** for a very special live screening of the Al Jazeera English[ documentary "The Night Won't End."](https://substack.com/redirect/272b63f9-689f-430b-a40c-e5399fea703b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) This powerful film tells the stories of three Palestinian families in Gaza fighting to survive a genocidal Israeli war facilitated by U.S. government weapons and support. "The Night Won't End" is one of the most vital pieces of journalism produced about the 11-month war against the Palestinians of Gaza, and I highly recommend you make the time to watch it. Laila is the film's executive producer and Sharif, who is now on the Drop Site team, was its correspondent.
For those of you who have been following this war - if it can even be called that - for the last 11 months, it may seem like too much to take in a film telling the story from the ground. Yet it somehow manages to be a profoundly important document, one that I think is very much worth your time.
RSVP for a link to join. Following the film, Jeremy will host a roundtable discussion and Q&A.
[RSVP TODAY](https://substack.com/redirect/c65b1409-2741-4a93-9fdb-a08086273146?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The live screening and event is open [to all Drop Site News subscribers, but ](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0ff334-4398-41d0-afc8-e36daab0b5d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[we will only be taking questions for the Q&A from ](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0ff334-4398-41d0-afc8-e36daab0b5d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[paid](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0ff334-4398-41d0-afc8-e36daab0b5d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[subscribers](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0ff334-4398-41d0-afc8-e36daab0b5d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[.](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0ff334-4398-41d0-afc8-e36daab0b5d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) If you want to submit questions for me, Sharif, or Laila, make sure to support our journalism and upgrade today. You can also make a one-time or recurring[ tax deductible contribution](https://substack.com/redirect/37b6437f-d2ec-4d94-8a8c-45ad787bf6b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to support our work.
_**[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/ef0ff334-4398-41d0-afc8-e36daab0b5d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
**I 'm writing you from Dearborn,** where the film was screened last night at the Arab-American Anti-Discrimination Committee conference. I was here for a panel on genocide and journalism with the Laila, the film's executive producer, and Said Arikat, the legendary reporter you've probably seen pestering the State Department at briefings over the past two decades.
Much of the talk at the conference was about whether the community would wind up supporting Kamala Harris in the general election. The consensus seemed to be that the vast majority will. Green Party nominee Jill Stein, ahead of Harris in some polls of Muslim voters here, even spoke on opening night and was given quite a warm welcome.
**Two other major topics of conversation:** Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel, a Democrat, on Thursday [charged 7 student protesters with felonies](https://substack.com/redirect/9f219907-a715-4815-86fd-11002baa07a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) related to campus encampments. As one elected official at the conference told me, Nessel ran on a promise to hold former Republican Gov. Rick Snyder responsible for the Flint water crisis and related cover-up, but never managed to do so, yet found a way to hit student protesters with felonies.
The other involved an election for University of Michigan's board of regents. Two of the board's eight regents are elected per cycle, and student protesters organized behind Huwaida Arraf, a civil rights attorney. Some 600 or more students packed the Michigan Democratic Convention in August to back their candidate, but instead of embracing the willingness of the students to operate inside the Democratic tent, they were treated even worse than the uncommitted delegates at the Democratic National Convention. The announcement of the results was delayed until the very end of the convention, when an official quietly declared Arraf had lost and quickly adjourned the convention, stunning the sea of hundreds of yellow Huwaida-shirted students. The party has not released the complicated formula that weighted the votes. The final tally showed some 200 more people voted than had been signed up to vote ahead of time and [Arraf is now suing over the opacity](https://substack.com/redirect/195a2c45-60d7-4c64-9b82-c22b5cd1fd76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The collective sense at the convention is that the Democratic Party is not just not doing anything to win their votes, but is actively hostile toward the Arab and Muslim community in Michigan.
If you're free Tuesday evening, I think you'll find the film a meaningful use of your time.
**Sharif Abdel Kouddous** is an independent journalist who has received a George Polk Award for his investigation into the killing of Palestinian journalist Shireen Abu Akleh, an Emmy award for his coverage of the Trump administration's Muslim travel ban, and an Izzy Award for his coverage of the 2011 Egyptian revolution. Sharif is also a producer of the Palestine Festival of Literature (PalFest). Sharif has recently joined the team as a contributor to Drop Site News.
**Laila Al-Arian** is an award-winning investigative journalist and filmmaker, and an executive producer of Fault Lines, a documentary program on Al Jazeera English. She has been honored with two News and Documentary Emmy Awards, 15 Emmy nominations, a Peabody Award, a Robert F. Kennedy Award in journalism and a National Headliner Award.
Looking forward to seeing you all Tuesday at 8 p.m. ET to watch and reflect on this important work.

Hey Peter,

I was on the ground in Nevada recently, and let me tell you — when Nevada says **“battle born, battle ready,”** _they’re not playing around._ Like Kamala Harris always says, **“when we fight, we win!”** [ ](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/IuQi7VwG79OGvz6XP0cmdQ~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRoxyKOP0TQaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1udmRlbXM_cmVmY29kZT0yMDI0MDkxM19lbV9mcl9iMV9udmRlbXNzcGxpdF9lbiZhbW91bnQ9MjcmY2RtYz0ybTFUSVNGQUkxU1FnUjNBZ2xIY3lvRzZDN20mcmVmY29kZTI9Mm0xVElTRkFJMVNRZ1IzQWdsSGN5b0c2QzdtJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJtMVRJU0ZBSTFTUWdSM0FnbEhjeW9HNkM3bVcDc3BjQgpm4Y6d5GaEvXVdUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) During my quick trip, I stayed busy meeting hundreds of fired-up volunteers, activists, and staff who are ready to make history and elect our first Madame President.
