body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92767781/498233043/1636625507?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmM2NDc2ZjctMGM3Mi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jccuSNj7k1OSSM42dQx47fxWJ2PKmWnHxCXDkuSlTUI=) Friend, I am running to serve CA-30, but I’m still your Assemblymember until the year ends. Others may have made campaigning their full-time job, but I was elected to make change for the better, and I never stopped doing my job. I'm proud to share that this work has paid off. Let me share five of the bills that I authored which have reached Governor Newsom’s desk. If signed, they will have a meaningful impact on Californians in Glendale, our district, and across the state: **The Room to Roam Act (AB 1889),** enhances wildlife connectivity and prioritizes corridors to allow our biodiversity to thrive, allowing us to thrive. Wildlife connectivity corridors protect both human and animal life by providing protected spaces for animals to migrate while reducing traffic collisions and other unwanted interactions. **Wetlands Forever (AB 2875),** protects California’s precious and dwindling wetlands from a recent Supreme Court decision which dismantled protections for our nation’s wetlands. Our wetlands are critical habitat for our state's native species and serve as natural barriers protecting us from flooding. They are not for sale. **Universal Basic Income (AB 2263),** evaluates existing programs & develops best practices so that California will know how to implement future UBI programs. Universal basic income has been shown to increase employment and decrease poverty and homelessness, and it’s important that we get this right to break the cycle of deep poverty. **Paraquat Evaluation (AB 1963),** forces the Department of Pesticide Regulation to reevaluate, and hopefully ban, paraquat. Every Californian relies on crops grown on local farms to feed their family, and growing and picking our food shouldn’t cause the farmworkers who feed us to contract Parkinson's disease or cancer. **Ending Sexual Assault on College Campuses (AB 810),** helps prevent professors and coaches credibly accused of harassment or sexual assault from being hired at new campuses and endangering new students. Sexual impropriety should never mar what should be some of the best years of young adults’ lives. I will never stop bringing the fight for basic decency and well-being of our neighbors and community – in Glendale, and in Washington. clean_body: | = Friend, I am running to serve CA-30, but I’m still your Assemblymember until the year ends. Others may have made campaigning their full-time job, but I was elected to make change for the better, and I never stopped doing my job. I'm proud to share that this work has paid off. Let me share five of the bills that I authored which have reached Governor Newsom’s desk. If signed, they will have a meaningful impact on Californians in Glendale, our district, and across the state: The Room to Roam Act (AB 1889), enhances wildlife connectivity and prioritizes corridors to allow our biodiversity to thrive, allowing us to thrive. Wildlife connectivity corridors protect both human and animal life by providing protected spaces for animals to migrate while reducing traffic collisions and other unwanted interactions. Wetlands Forever (AB 2875), protects California’s precious and dwindling wetlands from a recent Supreme Court decision which dismantled protections for our nation’s wetlands. Our wetlands are critical habitat for our state's native species and serve as natural barriers protecting us from flooding. They are not for sale. Universal Basic Income (AB 2263), evaluates existing programs & develops best practices so that California will know how to implement future UBI programs. Universal basic income has been shown to increase employment and decrease poverty and homelessness, and it’s important that we get this right to break the cycle of deep poverty. Paraquat Evaluation (AB 1963), forces the Department of Pesticide Regulation to reevaluate, and hopefully ban, paraquat. Every Californian relies on crops grown on local farms to feed their family, and growing and picking our food shouldn’t cause the farmworkers who feed us to contract Parkinson's disease or cancer. Ending Sexual Assault on College Campuses (AB 810), helps prevent professors and coaches credibly accused of harassment or sexual assault from being hired at new campuses and endangering new students. Sexual impropriety should never mar what should be some of the best years of young adults’ lives. I will never stop bringing the fight for basic decency and well-being of our neighbors and community – in Glendale, and in Washington. body:
#
I’m going back to college.
In fact, I’m going to nearly every college in Texas over the next 24 days to register and help turn out the thousands of students who can make the difference in big elections up and down the ballot.
We’re calling it the Ready to Vote tour, because our Powered by People volunteers will be there to not only register new voters, but to help already registered voters update their address in the voter file, check to make sure they haven’t been purged from the rolls and to serve as a resource (a “voting sherpa”!) for young voters participating in their first election.
This coming week I’ll be at UT San Antonio, Texas State, University of Houston and Texas A&M – and that’s just the start.
We are also booked at UT Dallas, University of North Texas and many more campuses across the state.
Is there a college student in your life that might want to join us? The first two weeks of the tour are up and you can RSVP here: **[poweredxpeople.org/ready-to-vote-tour/](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63708?t=1&akid=239806%2E444211%2EMEGHbw)**
More dates will be added soon – so please check back at the link above if your college is not on there yet.
[**And if you can’t join us but want to support our work, you can always donate to ensure we have the resources to stay on the road and register every eligible student.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240913.ZI2yaG&refcode=ema20240913-239806&t=2&akid=239806%2E444211%2EMEGHbw)
We’ll see you out there!
Beto

# **RITE Statement on Victory in PA Supreme Court on Undated Mail Ballots**
#
HARRISBURG, PA, September 13, 2024 – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to protect election security and integrity, today issued the following statement regarding a ruling from the Pennsylvania Supreme Court that undated mail-in ballots will not be counted.

RITE President Derek Lyons issued the following statement:

"RITE applauds the Pennsylvania Supreme Court for overturning a shameful lower court ruling that said that asking people to write a date on the envelope in which they transmit their mail-in ballots imposes a ‘severe burden’ on their ability to vote. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court's decision restores a measure of sanity to the state's administration of its elections."

name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: My September newsletter is here!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chrissy Houlahan for Congress
body:
A Note From Chrissy

If you're a parent, I hope you're experiencing the excitement (and relief!) that comes with that first week of school. Although my daughters are well past school age, August was filled with plenty of excitement (and some relief!) – and I'm eager to share updates with you!

Taking the DNC stage with other elected veterans

I had the privilege of joining over 100 fellow delegates from Pennsylvania in Chicago to celebrate our ticket - Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz. In addition to the convention speeches you see on TV, there are a bunch of meetings, panels, and, yes, parties. Since my favorite evening is one spent in my pajamas with a glass of red wine, I mostly skipped the parties. 🙂

If you watched the convention on Thursday night and saw the tribute to veterans, maybe you caught my appearance: I had the chance to get on stage with my fellow veterans serving in Congress to highlight support for the Harris-Walz ticket among veterans.

I have the deepest respect for Governor Walz's impressive service record and the 24 years he wore the uniform. I have absolute confidence that he and Vice President Harris will lead with our service members and veterans top of mind. As Congressman Ruben Gallego said, they "don't just respect our service, but revere it."

Visiting the Site of the Attempted Assassination

As a member of the Bipartisan Task Force on the Attempted Assassination of Donald J. Trump, it's my job to get the answers that the American people deserve. One of our first actions was to visit the site in Butler and meet with law enforcement.

As a veteran, but also as an operator and systems engineer, I'm committed to using my unique understanding of systems, procedures and protocols to help discover what happened on that day. I look forward to working with my colleagues, combing through the facts, and pushing through improvement so this never happens again.

Securing community funding for our youth

For over 20 years, the Garage Youth Center has empowered students in Kennett Square and Avondale to pursue the potential in every aspect of their lives. That's why, this year, I was proud to secure $112,500 for the center in a Community Project Funding grant.

I stopped by a few weeks ago to get an update on their work and see the plans for the renovation of their Avondale facility. I look forward to visiting again when the rain garden, green roof, and outdoor classroom are done!

Recent Labor Endorsements

I'm honored to have earned the endorsements recently of the AFL-CIO, the NEA-PSEA (teachers!), PASNAP (nurses!), and NASW-PACE (social workers!). Pennsylvania has a rich, impressive labor history, and unions continue to be at the forefront of ensuring all working people get a fair shake and the paycheck their hard work deserves. In Congress, I'll continue to be a fierce advocate for our unions and working families across Chester and Berks counties.

That's all for now! We're just two months out from Election Day, and I'll be back with plenty of exciting updates in the weeks ahead.

As always, thank you for being a part of this team and choosing me to do this important work on your behalf.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?refcode=jtk1041-ot-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250

There’s work to be done,

Chrissy

clean_body: A Note From Chrissy If you're a parent, I hope you're experiencing the excitement (and relief!) that comes with that first week of school. Although my daughters are well past school age, August was filled with plenty of excitement (and some relief!) – and I'm eager to share updates with you! Taking the DNC stage with other elected veterans I had the privilege of joining over 100 fellow delegates from Pennsylvania in Chicago to celebrate our ticket - Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz. In addition to the convention speeches you see on TV, there are a bunch of meetings, panels, and, yes, parties. Since my favorite evening is one spent in my pajamas with a glass of red wine, I mostly skipped the parties. 🙂 If you watched the convention on Thursday night and saw the tribute to veterans, maybe you caught my appearance: I had the chance to get on stage with my fellow veterans serving in Congress to highlight support for the Harris-Walz ticket among veterans. I have the deepest respect for Governor Walz's impressive service record and the 24 years he wore the uniform. I have absolute confidence that he and Vice President Harris will lead with our service members and veterans top of mind. As Congressman Ruben Gallego said, they "don't just respect our service, but revere it." Visiting the Site of the Attempted Assassination As a member of the Bipartisan Task Force on the Attempted Assassination of Donald J. Trump, it's my job to get the answers that the American people deserve. One of our first actions was to visit the site in Butler and meet with law enforcement. As a veteran, but also as an operator and systems engineer, I'm committed to using my unique understanding of systems, procedures and protocols to help discover what happened on that day. I look forward to working with my colleagues, combing through the facts, and pushing through improvement so this never happens again. Securing community funding for our youth For over 20 years, the Garage Youth Center has empowered students in Kennett Square and Avondale to pursue the potential in every aspect of their lives. That's why, this year, I was proud to secure $112,500 for the center in a Community Project Funding grant. I stopped by a few weeks ago to get an update on their work and see the plans for the renovation of their Avondale facility. I look forward to visiting again when the rain garden, green roof, and outdoor classroom are done! Recent Labor Endorsements I'm honored to have earned the endorsements recently of the AFL-CIO, the NEA-PSEA (teachers!), PASNAP (nurses!), and NASW-PACE (social workers!). Pennsylvania has a rich, impressive labor history, and unions continue to be at the forefront of ensuring all working people get a fair shake and the paycheck their hard work deserves. In Congress, I'll continue to be a fierce advocate for our unions and working families across Chester and Berks counties. That's all for now! We're just two months out from Election Day, and I'll be back with plenty of exciting updates in the weeks ahead. As always, thank you for being a part of this team and choosing me to do this important work on your behalf. There’s work to be done, Chrissy

So if you have a minute, I wanted to tell you a little bit about my story. ([_**If you don’t have a minute, but you’re all in on helping us win this race, here’s a link to pitch in a few dollars.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92769002/498236902/1085920126?refcode=email_091324_story&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOGYzNTQ4ZS0xMDcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xQj_SsGuvoJ6SnReNn2pN74hjFnOrBQ6d7vhqkPO2IY=)) When my dad was five years old, he immigrated from Mexico to Texas. He picked cotton and tomatoes in the fields of the Rio Grande Valley, working long days — like so many Americans do — all the while dreaming that one day he would work his way out of poverty and make it to the middle class. I grew up believing that if we worked hard anything was possible. But when I got to college, I realized my parents — even though they had worked so hard and done everything right — couldn’t stay afloat financially if they also had to pay my tuition. It just wasn’t doable. So I put myself through school — working all kinds of odd jobs to make ends meet. It took seven years, but I got my degree. **That got me thinking: How could it be this difficult, when we had all worked so hard? And, I know that’s a question on the minds of so many families today across Oregon and our nation.** I ran for Congress because I believe Oregon deserves leaders who will work hard every day to make life better for all of us. I’ve worked hard to deliver progress, and I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together so far. But we need to win this battleground seat and flip the House blue if we’re going to make the kind of change the American people deserve, . [_**There is so much on the line. And while I’d love to be able to tell you that we’ve got it in the bag, the truth is we’re tied. In the [post I just sent out](https://substack.com/redirect/72a85423-def5-4d0b-838a-1e684d702936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), inviting you to[ this virtual film screening Tuesday, ](https://substack.com/redirect/7e5ed9b9-2057-498a-8bc1-237b6a010357?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a typo in a line about the conference I'm attending changed the meaning by 180 degrees. Sorry about that. I sent this out quickly from the airport as I wait for my delayed flight to get going.
The key lines should have read: "Much of the talk at the conference was about whether the community would wind up supporting Kamala Harris in the general election. The consensus seemed to be that the vast majority will **not do so. " **
It's been corrected online. The full passage:
**I 'm writing you from Dearborn,** where the film was screened last night at the Arab-American Anti-Discrimination Committee conference. I was here for a panel on genocide and journalism with the Laila, the film's executive producer, and Said Arikat, the legendary reporter you've probably seen pestering the State Department at briefings over the past two decades.
Much of the talk at the conference was about whether the community would wind up supporting Kamala Harris in the general election. The consensus seemed to be that the vast majority will **not do so.** Green Party nominee Jill Stein, ahead of Harris in some polls of Muslim voters here, even spoke on opening night and was given quite a warm welcome.
**Two other major topics of conversation:** Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel, a Democrat, on Thursday [charged 7 student protesters with felonies](https://substack.com/redirect/a8626954-835b-46cd-b7bf-29756a5ae6cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) related to campus encampments. As one elected official at the conference told me, Nessel ran on a promise to hold former Republican Gov. Rick Snyder responsible for the Flint water crisis and related cover-up, but never managed to do so, yet found a way to hit student protesters with felonies.
The other involved an election for University of Michigan's board of regents. Two of the board's eight regents are elected per cycle, and student protesters organized behind Huwaida Arraf, a civil rights attorney. Some 600 or more students packed the Michigan Democratic Convention in August to back their candidate, but instead of embracing the willingness of the students to operate inside the Democratic tent, they were treated even worse than the uncommitted delegates at the Democratic National Convention. The announcement of the results was delayed until the very end of the convention, when an official quietly declared Arraf had lost and quickly adjourned the convention, stunning the sea of hundreds of yellow Huwaida-shirted students. The party has not released the complicated formula that weighted the votes. The final tally showed some 200 more people voted than had been signed up to vote ahead of time and [Arraf is now suing over the opacity](https://substack.com/redirect/5e3032f3-95df-43cb-8f28-3d0d1d73eb89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The collective sense at the convention is that the Democratic Party is not just not doing anything to win their votes, but is actively hostile toward the Arab and Muslim community in Michigan.

_Join the Hoosiers for Harris Movement_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92769382/498238179/-1164949491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY4NWVjNC0xMTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kuzOJJvyVvXrd24b0-yEapOz9CQxPxcs2WX0wzPUqYI=&emci=521b0162-0072-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=21685ec4-1172-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4925535)** This week, INDems launched _**[Hoosiers for Harris](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92769383/498238180/-546288838?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY4NWVjNC0xMTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kuzOJJvyVvXrd24b0-yEapOz9CQxPxcs2WX0wzPUqYI=&emci=521b0162-0072-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=21685ec4-1172-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4925535)**_ , a new grassroots project and website to promote Kamala Harris’s historic bid for the presidency. The site is dedicated to mobilizing Hoosier voters and growing grassroots support for Kamala Harris across Indiana. We invite you to check it out and lend your support ahead of the election! **** _Republican LG Candidate Micah Beckwith Only Promises Chaos_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92769385/498238182/710676706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY4NWVjNC0xMTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kuzOJJvyVvXrd24b0-yEapOz9CQxPxcs2WX0wzPUqYI=&emci=521b0162-0072-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=21685ec4-1172-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4925535)**[ Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92769386/498238183/710676706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY4NWVjNC0xMTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kuzOJJvyVvXrd24b0-yEapOz9CQxPxcs2WX0wzPUqYI=&emci=521b0162-0072-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=21685ec4-1172-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4925535) This week, Republican Lieutenant Governor candidate Micah Beckwith was a guest on a rightwing Christian podcast hosted by two sisters self-titled “the Resistance Chicks.” During the [podcast,](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92769387/498238184/976355717?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY4NWVjNC0xMTcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kuzOJJvyVvXrd24b0-yEapOz9CQxPxcs2WX0wzPUqYI=&emci=521b0162-0072-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=21685ec4-1172-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4925535) Micah discussed the role of lieutenant governor and argued that it should have more power than it is given: “In that moment when [LG Suzanne Crouch] said the governor appointed me, I heard the lord say ‘force the conversation. Peter,

Martin Heinrich has been in Washington, D.C. for a decade and a half, and he loves it.

He loves it because he doesn’t have to deal with us here in New Mexico while he’s there, and he thinks he can get away with whatever he wants with zero accountability – including lying, which is what he’s resorted to in order to hold onto the power that he loves so much.

**Heinrich knows that he is in serious trouble with New Mexico voters and that the only way to beat me now is to blatantly lie about me and my record.**

[**I need your help to step up our fundraising during these final two months**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=157f13d32f02492cb8a656ba21db9ac4&_e=pHfF_ip20orCskMnZ5M-UiZywvvTYCl9aOS320e6AXtbm6fndP_DIYLNK-4DvmNtXNYdClb4aeF2R3IXqgqnpPGZjkHEHWLOQ7v2tK6lSChqsVrQa2ygjNPe9DvSWdT-CCU6WwHY4IEoQTel5lQwPW1MA--yvOYVNenAity388eTIl3JopRRHvnRPQ7zexS7-CaFMc1M_LvdCZcAelOqOCN978ck7tbkimPJPLJ_D0hCKsMFDtbg_UpJ-WyuvKW4FBsgoj5WyGSL69TvSmutVx4hL2IE8BOZW8MPJtUfAVBQY3b3LunDNSYmxT-8mAvLKmZUfVG9OUyE-QMKZiufv_SlrGPa1nTCuUqEB9Il1SEmAbAgE4lzEp2TvP_V9DYl) so we can set the record straight and ensure voters know the truth, both about me and about Heinrich’s radical and failed record.

[ ** STEP IT UP FOR NELLA » **](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=157f13d32f02492cb8a656ba21db9ac4&_e=pHfF_ip20orCskMnZ5M-UiZywvvTYCl9aOS320e6AXtbm6fndP_DIYLNK-4DvmNtXNYdClb4aeF2R3IXqgqnpPGZjkHEHWLOQ7v2tK6lSChqsVrQa2ygjNPe9DvSWdT-CCU6WwHY4IEoQTel5lQwPW1MA--yvOYVNenAity388eTIl3JopRRHvnRPQ7zexS7-CaFMc1M_LvdCZcAelOqOCN978ck7tbkimPJPLJ_D0g5ISHqnrTTBGvwL5FOf0RSZXd5GlAwREbXJHzuVO1zulAK1DfOarwbRz_yE3xqg9Q3K_yNsg1U6qY0ZUt5pO6TumyiOQpMJ-LEHKabqFQbRHOaPeMPE5_R-eMZaqkRnpO4HagpRaf_iVbHhDZ7SyuA)
Heinrich and the Democrats NEVER thought they would be in danger in this seat, _but they also never saw us coming._

**Now, we’re on the brink of taking the lead in this race and flipping New Mexico.**

All we need is to step up our fundraising so we can continue competing with Heinrich’s spending scramble.

[**Will you help us combat his lies with a generous contribution today?**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=157f13d32f02492cb8a656ba21db9ac4&_e=pHfF_ip20orCskMnZ5M-UiZywvvTYCl9aOS320e6AXtbm6fndP_DIYLNK-4DvmNtXNYdClb4aeF2R3IXqgqnpPGZjkHEHWLOQ7v2tK6lSChqsVrQa2ygjNPe9DvSWdT-CCU6WwHY4IEoQTel5lQwPW1MA--yvOYVNenAity388eTIl3JopRRHvnRPQ7zexS7-CaFMc1M_LvdCZcAelOqOCN978ck7tbkimPJPLJ_D0jrwYb3Gt0NoKfsngWnNmxs_S7CAD2D8mvQfyrmzGUevWSwRLsvkCsCMp2WwY4v5Xba3ycobKLtHC7AITEX66nlLW04x16679lMfcsSAO5k8TBkvOBCyIkI6rVWxHZjJtHIk-IZvA2BzRxNlwORx4Gi)

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friend, Arizona is about 33% Latino. If I win my race, it’ll be the first time any of those people will see someone who looks like them representing our state in the U.S. Senate.

I could be Arizona’s first Latino Senator, but I won’t get there without your help. [**If you’ve got my back and are ready to make that happen, could you make a split donation of $10 to help us win this race and to help Fight for Reform elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51287?t=7&akid=22054%2E4449941%2EgagpT_) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Ruben Gallego will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51288?t=8&akid=22054%2E4449941%2EgagpT_)

Kids who grow up the way I did don’t make their way to the U.S. Senate. Statistically speaking, I never should’ve made it to college.

But thanks to my mom, my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into Harvard.

I served in the Marines, and I fought in Iraq.

I came back, and I got elected to Congress. I served almost 10 years, fighting for my people. And now, I’m taking on Kari Lake and the MAGA-right to defend Arizona and take back a critical seat in the U.S. Senate.

Talking heads have been telling us for months that this race would come down to the wire, and right now the polls are narrowing considerably. It’s a fight to the finish. What I need more than anything else is the resources to fight back against the waves of attacks and ads coming my way.

To win, I need you to join me in this fight. With you, we can do it. Without you, I don’t have a shot.
[**Please, can you afford to split $10 to help Fight for Reform elect state and local Democrats and to help me become the first Latino Senator from Arizona? A Senator for ALL Arizonans, no matter what party they belong to or what country their family came from.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51287?t=13&akid=22054%2E4449941%2EgagpT_)

Thank you,

Ruben

subject: There's no debate: this week reminds us why American leadership matters
body:
23 years post-9/11, America's greatest threat lost his mind behind a debate podium | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/33aa24768e4c/theres-no-debate-this-week-reminds-us-why-american-leadership-matters?e=5d7e9a146c)

|

## There’s no debate: American leadership matters
Hello ,

Lost in the midst of a tense presidential election cycle sits a solemn day - September 11th - earlier this week marking 23 years since our nation and its course was forever changed.
Like many of you, I went about that morning as I’d done many before - settling in at work, only to find myself, my students and fellow Coker College faculty drawn to watching a horrific scene unfold on nearby television screens. In a matter of hours, we lost nearly three thousand fellow Americans to a gruesome coordinated terror attack - the worst of its kind ever on American soil.
The shock, the grief and yes, the anger steeled our collective resolve to unite as “one nation” to bring justice to those behind that heinous day’s terror. That unity surely sent shivers down the spines of our enemies, as fleeting as it then was.
It’s that sense of “unity” this nation must return to. Instead, we were led into two costly, deadly and unnecessary wars.
The lives we lost that day, and on battlefields before and after it, cannot have been lost in vain. Those memories should steel our resolve to _do_ better; to _be_ better.
Tuesday night, like many of you, I watched as the two options we have to lead this nation made their pitches, and like many of you, I came away both gobsmacked and awestruck. Gobsmacked that anyone believes Donald Trump should be within shouting distance of the Oval Office again and awestruck by the calm and determined resolve shown by Vice President Kamala Harris. While Trump name-dropped brutal dictators like Viktor Orban, Harris touted our strengthened alliances with NATO nation members. While Trump vowed to cave to Vladimir Putin on day one, Harris pledged to stand with Ukraine; and while we’re on the subject of 9/11 ... it was Trump who literally said _“I got involved with the Taliban.”_
His rationale?
_“The Taliban was killing our soldiers; a lot of them... I got involved ... because the Taliban was doing the killing.”_
A former commander-in-chief _admitted_ he sought to negotiate with a terror organization in response to their attacking our men and women in uniform. That alone should be disqualifying. The resulting calamity of our exit and the casualties suffered at Abbey Gate can be traced back to his awful choice to “get involved with the Taliban.” Vice President Kamala Harris clearly won Tuesday night’s debate and, God willing, will be elected President on November 5th; but Donald Trump did provide us the reminder we needed when it comes to what’s down the ballot, too.
Codifying ‘Roe v Wade’ won’t be possible, without a Congress in Democratic control. Strengthening the Affordable Care Act won’t be possible without Democrats holding the Senate, and taking back the House, either. Seeing to it that Putin is defeated ... that a ceasefire in Gaza is reached ... that our education system is well-funded and staffed ... that college is affordable ... that small business can prosper and that Americans take home a living wage ... none of it’s possible without controlling the House, the Senate and the White House in the hands of those who bring ideas instead of those who seek to obstruct those ideas.
When I’m in Congress, on a multitude of issues, I’ll have Kamala Harris and Tim Walz’ backs. WIll you join the fight and have my back?
That “unity” we felt on September 12 nearly 23 years ago today is - I believe - closer than ever before. Republicans - many who were in office that day - have joined our cause to prevent a second Trump presidency. This November - up and down the ballot - we need a once-in-a-generational outcome.
Are you with us?

Friend, This week, the Israeli military added to its long list of unconscionable war crimes, including:
* **Dropping multiple 2,000-pound U.S. bombs on a densely populated refugee camp** in Gaza’s al-Mawasi area, a so-called “humanitarian zone” where Israel’s military has forced 1 million displaced Palestinians to go. Designed to destroy fortified underground bunkers, these “bunker buster” bombs disintegrated tents and entire families, creating 30-feet-deep craters in the ground.

* **Violently blocking the international effort to provide children in Gaza with polio vaccines.** Stopping one convoy of UN vehicles at gunpoint, Israeli forces fired shots, encircled the vehicles, and rammed into them with tanks and a bulldozer.
* **Destroying 70% of civilian infrastructure in Jenin, a city in the West Bank,** with bombs and armored bulldozers. A Palestinian health minister visited Jenin and said, _“No place in Palestine is safe, not just Gaza.”_

**In July, the world’s top court ruled that Israel’s presence in the occupied Palestinian territories is unlawful and must end “as rapidly as possible.”** The court noted that Israel is violating Palestinians’ right to self-determination and that other countries must stop supporting Israel’s illegal presence in Gaza, the West Bank, and East Jerusalem. To affirm this ruling, **Palestinian representatives are now circulating a proposed resolution in the United Nations** calling on Israel to withdraw its military forces from the occupied Palestinian territories. This week, Palestine was seated among United Nations “member states” for the first time.
The vast majority of countries in the United Nations voted to accept Palestine as a full member state, but the U.S. vetoed that measure and blocked it from becoming official. For now, Palestine cannot vote on resolutions but has some rights in the UN General Assembly, such as introducing proposals.
Their new proposal lays out what the United Nations and its International Court of Justice have already made clear. Israel is an occupying power. Under international law, Israel’s government is obligated to end its occupation, and Palestinians have a right to self-determination in their homeland.
**Israel’s government has violated international humanitarian law for decades with impunity because countries like the United States refuse to hold it accountable.** Nearly a year into this well documented genocide, we’re seeing continued expansion of the campaign to annihilate and exterminate the Palestinian people.
Israel’s Prime Minister continues to refuse to withdraw military forces from Gaza—a key part of a permanent ceasefire deal. Now Israel’s military is similarly attacking the West Bank with a goal of total destruction.
[**Add your name to join the call: As part of the permanent ceasefire we’ve been demanding and as an important step toward Palestinians’ self-determination, Israel’s military must leave occupied Palestine now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9FmEIdHWaSFuNub_8h70Zd-AHncCWkmuCCBdAGcKcRv1o-DaaQPi3c2EL54Jc6lTYTVYRyyQly7IyCqzukyG_71d33mRoL14b7C3YHsBwT1D7gTWpG7kS7B_LGdZAjIMJG64I3JZpD4ExcVzYdmmgncaqnBWtUfnhc6Cw447Sn5BXBTTutjenaxGAdkkr61PNQiiVDvyeXx6sXFi-dAmnzqk52gJ_3f_lZQoMs1D8DBS9yhNW4DXf0trVF1A47Mq4PgvG607Iirgni-cvaSUj9LHTBn8QCT0lNSvETiIJb3NJGKxN9JgwK427D-3swVf-_U7eK5_0e3lrmJt4z6mv-vubdtUXyubttZVsZvvfdRTsepWMzgh0m0mKf4qGojvjk0SM8BiKrScKRRl-kQCe1ByKJ_iqU9nSGHhhjoC9uHCgMyixyi_byo55VSJJLhzUSbgkVE2YnfQgLkYTwGXT-eNlxb8Pt-MixQVS-S2Di2v_-beqESsnT7qKDmBxVSARZmKRwkk1Oiktw4x5LcCv5lGC76W4oEGQqg7xHDTRlj_f0/49q/077odQKGQVeNnx2kvdQXZg/h3/h001.mfLOkQHECA2a5ai8YU9zhQ47erdev8XqByM38tWMNnk)

I wanted to make sure you saw this email my team sent out following our decisive win in Tuesday’s primary.

They’ve already opened their campaign warchest to try and defeat Matt because they know he’s a fighter for the people who – unlike them – refuses to do the bidding of deep-pocketed special interests in Congress. Now more than ever, we need to do everything we can to protect the progress we’ve made and ensure we’re prepared for whatever they throw at us next. In 2018, California had 20 democratic women speaking for us in Congress, today we are down to 15 and next year even fewer — out of five seats currently held by retiring CA women, four are being replaced by men.
I’m no stranger to being the only woman in the room — I spent my career in National Security and more recently wildfire resilience. It taught me to speak up and stand up for my ideas even in the face of doubters and condescension. It taught me to build coalitions around an idea so even when small minded men weren’t able to accept the idea from a woman, we still got it done.
But when I decided to run for Congress in 2018, for the first time I wasn’t the only woman in the room. I stood in a sea of pink hats of women marching to demand that our rights be protected and our voices heard.
I know it feels like we’ve been losing ground since then — reproductive freedom is in peril, basic health care for women is being stripped away and the next generation of MAGA extremists like Kevin Kiley and JD Vance have no shame declaring that a woman’s only role in our country is child rearing (even post-menopausal women).
If Kevin Kiley, MAGA champion that Trump says he is, gets re-elected, he will drive through a national abortion ban. Even in a state like California, that means reproductive rights are at risk.
[**Ladies, we have to stop him. We are the heroes we are waiting for! Will you join EMILY’s List and help make sure that doesn’t happen?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/UD_cz-In7DbHlGdleb6ubA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoxzRgP0THaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL0pNQ0EtMDMtRW1haWwtU2VwdDIwMjQtRlItU2VwdGVtYmVyP3JlZmNvZGU9RTEwNTA5LTIwMjQwOTEzLUVNSUxZc0xpc3QmcmVmY29kZU5tcm9CbWlkPTUwOTA5MTUyMSYmcmVmY29kZT1FMTA1MDktMjAyNDA5MTMtRU1JTFlzTGlzdC1TTC1BYm9ydGlvblJlcHJvUmlnaHRzJmFtb3VudD0yNVcDc3BjQgpm4W-v5GaM7D8xUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAALQ~~)
I have been so grateful for the steadfast support of organizations like EMILYs list that uplift, empower and support women candidates like me, knowing how important it is to elect women to Congress who will deliver reproductive freedom, protect our rights, and drive solutions.

body:
Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter who said: “F with the NRA and you’ll be DOA.”

| Peter,

The reason change doesn’t happen is not because it’s impossible —**but because people think it is impossible.**

I believe this idea that change is impossible is the single greatest threat to American democracy. [_**Before I tell you more, can you take a moment to support our mission to elect young, progressive leaders by splitting a small donation with Fight for Progress and Leaders We Deserve?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92772216/498247101/150752135?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-09-13_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU5MmJiYWE4LTE3NzItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JtzioZRTK2RsHQREGhCaFe0ZXH8q1y258Dxo7t_c87Q=)

After Parkland, many adults said: **“What happened is terrible and it’s amazing you kids are standing up,_but you’ll never change anything because this is Florida._ ”** But guess what?

Outraged students and parents of victims — like Fred Guttenberg and Manuel Oliver — said we don’t care; we’re still going to try. We showed up and protested by the thousands in Tallahassee. And guess what? We actually did change gun laws. We raised the age to buy guns in Florida to 21 and passed a red flag law.

**Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter who said: “F with the NRA and you’ll be DOA.”**

We used the law we passed after Parkland to disarm the man who threatened to kill my mother, and since the passage of that law, **over 12,000 other people who were a risk to themselves or others have been disarmed.**

[_**Peter, if we didn’t have the audacity to hope – I may have had to bury my own mother. That’s why I’m still fighting to keep others safe from gun violence. Can you give $10 between Fight for Progress and Leaders We Deserve to support the work we’re doing to create a safer future?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92772217/498247102/150752135?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-09-13_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU5MmJiYWE4LTE3NzItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JtzioZRTK2RsHQREGhCaFe0ZXH8q1y258Dxo7t_c87Q=)
---
| [DONATE ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92772218/498247103/150752135?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-09-13_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU5MmJiYWE4LTE3NzItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JtzioZRTK2RsHQREGhCaFe0ZXH8q1y258Dxo7t_c87Q=)
---
A few years later, I hired a young guy named Maxwell Frost from my freshman dorm room in college to be the March for Our Lives National Organizing Director. In my junior year of college, he called me up and said he would have to leave March for Our Lives because he wanted to run for Congress and asked for my help.

Before this, I hadn’t really helped anyone run for office in a major way because I didn’t trust politicians who only wanted to use me to get elected and then do nothing about gun violence.

But I didn’t see Maxwell as a politician – I saw him as a friend, so I did everything I could to help him run.

Once again, I heard the same thing from professors and “experts:” “He’s too young.”

“He doesn’t have the political or donor connections to win.”

“How is he going to win against two former members of Congress?” I didn’t care and decided to keep supporting him because I knew what an incredible leader he could be, and I wanted to prove everyone who said it wasn’t possible wrong. So, I helped Maxwell raise $380,000 in his first two quarters, **which helped him win by a margin of 10% — _and he became the youngest member of Congress._**

Once elected, Maxwell’s first bill was to create a Federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention (something March for Our Lives had been pushing for over three years), and within 1 year of his election, Maxwell was introducing the President of the United States, who was announcing the creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. **That office has overseen a 20% reduction of gun homicides in the first quarter of 2024.**

If we listened to the people who said Maxwell couldn’t win, and if he didn’t bother to try, we wouldn’t have:
* The youngest and first Gen Z member of Congress;
* an Office of Gun Violence Prevention;
* first member of March for Our Lives in Congress.

[_**Peter, we’re changing the status quo and getting more young leaders elected to office. Can you donate $10 between Fight for Progress and Leaders We Deserve to fuel our work to elect young progressives up-and-down the ballot?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92772219/498247104/150752135?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-09-13_1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjU5MmJiYWE4LTE3NzItZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JtzioZRTK2RsHQREGhCaFe0ZXH8q1y258Dxo7t_c87Q=)
We are in a vicious cycle of cynicism and hopelessness that will destroy us if we don’t break it. Hopelessness is a self-fulfilling prophecy. If we never think things can get better, they never will.

That’s why – with Maxwell’s campaign manager, Kevin Lata – we created Leaders We Deserve. An organization dedicated to funding and advising the best Democrats of our generation to get them elected, so we can have leaders in office that will inspire young people to vote.

Our candidates are pro-gun reform, pro-choice, and pro-environment. They also don’t take money from large corporations and neither does Leaders We Deserve.

Just recently, we spent $300,000 supporting Molly Cook, who won by just 62 votes, and is now the youngest member of the Texas Senate.

CHANGE IS POSSIBLE! And we’re making it happen.

Peter, join the thousands of people supporting a better, more progressive future. We rely on grassroots support to get young progressives elected to office, and with November 5 getting closer, we need a big surge of donations to get across the finish line. clean_body: Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter who said: “F with the NRA and you’ll be DOA.” | Peter, The reason change doesn’t happen is not because it’s impossible —but because people think it is impossible. I believe this idea that change is impossible is the single greatest threat to American democracy. = After Parkland, many adults said: “What happened is terrible and it’s amazing you kids are standing up,but you’ll never change anything because this is Florida. ” But guess what? Outraged students and parents of victims — like Fred Guttenberg and Manuel Oliver — said we don’t care; we’re still going to try. We showed up and protested by the thousands in Tallahassee. And guess what? We actually did change gun laws. We raised the age to buy guns in Florida to 21 and passed a red flag law. Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter who said: “F with the NRA and you’ll be DOA.” We used the law we passed after Parkland to disarm the man who threatened to kill my mother, and since the passage of that law, over 12,000 other people who were a risk to themselves or others have been disarmed. = | = A few years later, I hired a young guy named Maxwell Frost from my freshman dorm room in college to be the March for Our Lives National Organizing Director. In my junior year of college, he called me up and said he would have to leave March for Our Lives because he wanted to run for Congress and asked for my help. Before this, I hadn’t really helped anyone run for office in a major way because I didn’t trust politicians who only wanted to use me to get elected and then do nothing about gun violence. But I didn’t see Maxwell as a politician – I saw him as a friend, so I did everything I could to help him run. Once again, I heard the same thing from professors and “experts:” “He’s too young.” “He doesn’t have the political or donor connections to win.” “How is he going to win against two former members of Congress?” I didn’t care and decided to keep supporting him because I knew what an incredible leader he could be, and I wanted to prove everyone who said it wasn’t possible wrong. So, I helped Maxwell raise $380,000 in his first two quarters, which helped him win by a margin of 10% — and he became the youngest member of Congress. Once elected, Maxwell’s first bill was to create a Federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention (something March for Our Lives had been pushing for over three years), and within 1 year of his election, Maxwell was introducing the President of the United States, who was announcing the creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. That office has overseen a 20% reduction of gun homicides in the first quarter of 2024. If we listened to the people who said Maxwell couldn’t win, and if he didn’t bother to try, we wouldn’t have: The youngest and first Gen Z member of Congress; an Office of Gun Violence Prevention; first member of March for Our Lives in Congress. = We are in a vicious cycle of cynicism and hopelessness that will destroy us if we don’t break it. Hopelessness is a self-fulfilling prophecy. If we never think things can get better, they never will. That’s why – with Maxwell’s campaign manager, Kevin Lata – we created Leaders We Deserve. An organization dedicated to funding and advising the best Democrats of our generation to get them elected, so we can have leaders in office that will inspire young people to vote. Our candidates are pro-gun reform, pro-choice, and pro-environment. They also don’t take money from large corporations and neither does Leaders We Deserve. Just recently, we spent $300,000 supporting Molly Cook, who won by just 62 votes, and is now the youngest member of the Texas Senate. CHANGE IS POSSIBLE! And we’re making it happen. Peter, join the thousands of people supporting a better, more progressive future. We rely on grassroots support to get young progressives elected to office, and with November 5 getting closer, we need a big surge of donations to get across the finish line. = | = | = | = | = | = We’re in this fight together. **My name is Dan Osborn, and I am the candidate running for U.S. Senate against Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska.**

| | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. body:
I won’t sugarcoat this. I’m in the fight of my life. The attacks by Chuck Schumer, Kamala Harris, and Tammy Baldwin have been relentless. | Fellow Conservative, I won’t sugarcoat this. I’m in the fight of my life.

The attacks by Chuck Schumer, Kamala Harris, and Tammy Baldwin have been relentless. They’re rushing millions of dollars into Wisconsin to prop up Tammy Baldwin and salvage this seat.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92772906/498249813/-1295403277?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240913_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTc5MTc4NS0xYjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uuK1-kjjvoDmDWL32PfvIrCq7QAxHAYP-N_1_m-81vU=&emci=d97999ad-1272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=3e791785-1b72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=15529135) | Friend, this Hunger Action Month, I am taking action in Congress with multiple pieces of legislation to continue the fight against childhood hunger. Last week, it was by introducing the _School Hunger Elimination Act_ , which would directly certify all school-age students receiving Medicaid or SNAP in the National School Lunch Program. As a teacher, I know firsthand that for many students, school is the only place where they receive a healthy meal. Hungry kids do not learn, yet nearly one in five children live in households without consistent access to adequate nutrition. Our common-sense approach would change that. But our work does not stop there. This week, I also introduced the _School Food Security Act_ , which removes barriers to accessing SNAP for low-income college students. As a teenage mom, I returned to community college. **I know what it means when these barriers are removed and students get the help they need, from the youngest students to those getting a college degree.** Together, these two bills would remove administrative barriers across tens of thousands of schools and strengthen a program that already serves millions of children. [**This is the approach I have taken in advocating for our students in CT-05. With our most important FEC fundraising deadline around the corner, I am counting on you now more than ever to help me win reelection and defeat my Trump-supporting opponent. clean_body: | | Friend, this Hunger Action Month, I am taking action in Congress with multiple pieces of legislation to continue the fight against childhood hunger. Last week, it was by introducing the School Hunger Elimination Act , which would directly certify all school-age students receiving Medicaid or SNAP in the National School Lunch Program. As a teacher, I know firsthand that for many students, school is the only place where they receive a healthy meal. Hungry kids do not learn, yet nearly one in five children live in households without consistent access to adequate nutrition. Our common-sense approach would change that. But our work does not stop there. This week, I also introduced the School Food Security Act , which removes barriers to accessing SNAP for low-income college students. As a teenage mom, I returned to community college. I know what it means when these barriers are removed and students get the help they need, from the youngest students to those getting a college degree. Together, these two bills would remove administrative barriers across tens of thousands of schools and strengthen a program that already serves millions of children. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Jahana Hayes | | About Jahana** Jahana Hayes proudly represents Connecticut's 5th Congressional district. | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Dear Fellow Patriot,

We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=550940a9c6cd442db26b64557984f936&_e=VbV6ENEYIYuFxTSi8vCCLFBTCERLPLRz_22Z7eS2eap-zW2gpkfrnObX19J586tsLj13xnirJtzzSsldG3uj8mGi_csm5QQWz9HtJFfagxYT1aObjvy4YiIszEq58xPydCp1de7MMMkhmlEwHlfcYeFi0a2-aoaFC5VtKLy825rOFzcUrAhXr_Grr9oKdh2NlQCawPA8Q1T4-xtH1L6Qf1Pu_85MAnv-E1FL6Ds7FJ6dbjv8oM4BRD_6DDIpPUupLFoAb-ROYHxZg5quQQE3uJi1Ll8nVEO27IIVizeSVso53jcZgWuQkwqWIoXNJ6MY0f3ao-gbUos-GgF9Ad6T3htHzr2aLEH0TrqpB2pk7n_rKEWSVYMFaZHzJ4WA7aFY98L75PlJyuCelumbK8G7TA%3D%3D) Your gift of $100 or more to ACI today will help strengthen the bonds of our communities by lifting up the virtues of faith, liberty, community, and life.

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

And to help pass down these important pillars to the next generation, I'lll also send you a free copy of my children's book "Why America Matters" that celebrates our great country and reminds us what a blessing it is to be an American.

You can make your secure gift here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/the-perilous-fight](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=550940a9c6cd442db26b64557984f936&_e=VbV6ENEYIYuFxTSi8vCCLFBTCERLPLRz_22Z7eS2eap-zW2gpkfrnObX19J586tsLj13xnirJtzzSsldG3uj8mGi_csm5QQWz9HtJFfagxYT1aObjvy4YiIszEq58xPydCp1de7MMMkhmlEwHlfcYeFi0a2-aoaFC5VtKLy825rOFzcUrAhXr_Grr9oKdh2NlQCawPA8Q1T4-xtH1L6Qf1Pu_85MAnv-E1FL6Ds7FJ6dbjv8oM4BRD_6DDIpPUupogRI2dm_pZXUpf5zUGAFZpwdRucPBhzdxvhQJteVCko1WvS9YfeihWfhQUQdU9Jaug9p2U5ehZGv9m4okLb4j89XK1cOTlkeYnFkxURcaUvllWu_ux-Ze1Rk9TnXt5AzVXtkHeYZjrOERrm5-GDBcw%3D%3D)

Thank you for your interest in preserving and strengthening America's families!

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Worried parents rush to Sharpstown International School but Houston police say reports of threat were a hoax,"** KHOU's**Michelle Homer** -- "Sharpstown International School in southwest Houston is the latest Texas school to deal with [fake threats of violence](https://substack.com/redirect/3fc47dc6-2115-4040-99d3-c1c458e7d421?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to the Houston Police Department.

Rumors of a weapon at the school spread on Friday afternoon and the school was put on lockdown.

HPD and HISD police responded and eventually determined it was a hoax. They said there was no shooting and no weapon was found.

Dozens of panicked parents also rushed to the school on [Triola Lane near S. Gessner](https://substack.com/redirect/64451326-ccde-41ef-b7e2-6ca5947273cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They gathered outside waiting for word from HPD or HISD officers and hoping to pick up their children.

Many said they saw rumors about a gun or shooting threat on social media.

"I heard it through another mother, so I hurry up and ran over here to get my nephew," one woman told us.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/de72471d-98f0-40c3-8633-f5f3bf678084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"We've just been waiting outside and they kept telling the parents to calm down, but how is a parent going to calm down?" another said.

Some students and parents said they saw someone get arrested but HPD and HISD haven't confirmed whether there was an arrest.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/de72471d-98f0-40c3-8633-f5f3bf678084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
After determining it was a hoax, a police officer used a megaphone to ask parents to clear the area so the lockdown could be lifted.

HISD sent the following statement just before 4 p.m.

_" We are aware of a reported security threat at Sharpstown International School involving a possible weapon on campus. HISD police and HPD are at the school and investigating. At this time, the threat is unsubstantiated. Students and staff are safe and there have been no injuries reported. Out of an abundance of caution the campus was placed on lockdown throughout the investigation and remains in a security hold. The campus team is working with parents who have arrived at the school on a controlled dismissal (this means students will be dismissed in stages). We understand this is a scary situation for families and HISD is in communication with them."" _[KHOU](https://substack.com/redirect/0ef894b4-e65a-4e96-a5d8-a3a0b117e442?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# I Am from the Government
### and I am Here to Help
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Sep 13
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
In this video, we dive into the classic phrase famously coined by Ronald Reagan: "The nine most terrifying words in the English language are: I'm from the government, and I'm here to help." Join us as we daily explore the humorous, ironic, and sometimes serious side of government intervention.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fce0d8b4-50c6-4980-8990-474a6aa32280?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
From well-intentioned programs that go wrong to bureaucratic red tape that complicates everything, this video sheds light on how policies designed to help can often do the opposite. Whether you're a fan of satire or looking for insightful commentary on the role of government, this video has something for everyone!

This week was amazing at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15299384.8645.1.67847a200ce50b3d9ea6c2a3bae2e4e5). We hosted our annual conference called **IGNITE 2024** with speakers: [Perry Stone](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15299384.8646.1.8149cb10098e76f0a4ad8106b0b7edb3), [Darryl Strawberry](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15299384.8647.1.d292e5c493f185aa107b6af36de04ae6), [Bishop Darrell Hines](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15299384.8648.1.1a0e9548b61a9e6559f8b3c32a6992f6) and [Dr. Randy Caldwell](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15299384.8649.1.4d87993403968f5f8dbd28388327965c). **Mrs. Giles** (pictured above) attended **IGNITE 2024** this week and after one of the services she told me a story. Over 30 years ago, her and a group of prayer warriors in Tulsa would go every Sunday night and lay hands on the **Caravan Night Club** and pray that one day God would take the _club_ and turn it in a _church_... **30 years later, God answered their prayers!** The **Caravan Night Club** has been transformed into [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=15299384.8650.1.b0b67fbb328e033909f8ae4f6dad7419). Literally from a Tavern to Tabernacle. Be encouraged that not only does God hear our prayers but He **REMEMBERS** them! | Peter,

While Bergman pretends to advocate for Upper and Northern Michiganders, his record paints another picture.

**He has been a long-time advocate for privatizing Social Security and Medicare, and he’s even proposed repealing the Affordable Care Act****._Yes, you heard that right._ This threatens to end the guaranteed benefits that so many of our seniors have relied on after years of hard work and contributions to these programs.**

Imagine the impact this would have on our community members who depend on these programs to make ends meet. These aren’t just numbers; these are our neighbors, our friends, and our family. They deserve better than to be left in the lurch by leaders playing political games.

I believe in protecting the promises made to our seniors and ensuring that Social Security and Medicare remain strong and secure.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Former Kentucky Attorney General Daniel Cameron to Speak at Judson University’s Constitution Day on Sept. 18 (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/former-kentucky-attorney-general-daniel-cameron-to-speak-at-judson-universitys-constitution-day-on-sept-18.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/former-kentucky-attorney-general-daniel-cameron-to-speak-at-judson-universitys-constitution-day-on-sept-18.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former Kentucky AG Daniel Cameron (Photo: KY AG Office)
By Illinois Review

On Wednesday, Judson University welcomes former Kentucky Attorney General Daniel Cameron as the keynote speaker during Constitution Day (https://www.judsonu.edu/judson-university-welcomes-dynamic-speakers-to-chapel-in-september-mattie-montgomery-and-daniel-cameron/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – an event the Chicagoland university celebrates each year.

Cameron is a historical figure in the Bluegrass State – having served as the first African American and Republican to serve as AG since 1943. In 2023, Cameron was the GOP nominee for governor, losing to incumbent Gov. Andy Beshear. Since leaving office, the former AG is CEO of the 1792 Exchange – an organization whose mission is to protect free exercise, free speech and free enterprise and help American corporations succeed without pushing political agendas.

Judson – a well connected university, hosts the World Leaders Forum each year to raise money for Roeser student scholarships and Judson’s RISE Program – a unique program designed for students with intellectual disabilities. Less than one percent of colleges and universities around the country offer a program similar to RISE. Over the last decade, the WLF has hosted leaders including former U.S. President George W. Bush, former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, former Soviet Union President Mikhail Gorbachev, former Mexican President Felipe Calderon, Queen Noor of Jordan, Ambassador Caroline Kennedy and General David Petraeus.

On October 3rd, the WLF welcomes former Canadian Prime Minister Stephen Harper, who served as the 22nd Prime Minister from 2006-2015. Tickets are still
available (https://www.judsonu.edu/world-leaders-forum/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , and the event takes place on campus at Herrick Chapel.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/former-kentucky-attorney-general-daniel-cameron-to-speak-at-judson-universitys-constitution-day-on-sept-18.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Eileen Burke’s First Amendment Prosecution Unit Targets Free Speech, Pro-Life Protesters (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/eileen-burkes-first-amendment-prosecution-unit-targets-free-speech-pro-life-protesters.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/eileen-burkes-first-amendment-prosecution-unit-targets-free-speech-pro-life-protesters.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f02f33b532-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Eileen O'Neill Burke, Democrat candidate for Cook County State's Attorney (Source: Illinois Review)
By Illinois Review

Eileen O’Neill Burke, the Democrat nominee for Cook County State’s Attorney, has unveiled a radical plan to create a “Choice Protection Unit” to target pro-life activists, which could have far-reaching consequences for free speech across Illinois.

Burke’s plan, if implemented, would prioritize prosecuting pro-life activists for exercising their First Amendment rights. Instead of focusing on real crime, such as the rampant shootings and murders that have left over 1,200 people shot and more than 400 dead in Chicago this year alone, Burke’s proposed “Choice Protection Unit”—which more accurately should be called a “First Amendment Prosecution Unit”—seeks to criminalize peaceful protests outside abortion clinics.

clean_body: Big news announced for Judson University's September 18 Constitutional Day; and candidate Burke unveils plans to prosecute anti-abortion protests. view in browser () | update preferences () | unsubscribe () This IR e-Blast Powered By: Dear Peter, We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump. Former Kentucky Attorney General Daniel Cameron to Speak at Judson University’s Constitution Day on Sept. 18 () Former Kentucky AG Daniel Cameron (Photo: KY AG Office) By Illinois Review On Wednesday, Judson University welcomes former Kentucky Attorney General Daniel Cameron as the keynote speaker during Constitution Day () – an event the Chicagoland university celebrates each year. Cameron is a historical figure in the Bluegrass State – having served as the first African American and Republican to serve as AG since 1943. In 2023, Cameron was the GOP nominee for governor, losing to incumbent Gov. Andy Beshear. Since leaving office, the former AG is CEO of the 1792 Exchange – an organization whose mission is to protect free exercise, free speech and free enterprise and help American corporations succeed without pushing political agendas. Judson – a well connected university, hosts the World Leaders Forum each year to raise money for Roeser student scholarships and Judson’s RISE Program – a unique program designed for students with intellectual disabilities. Less than one percent of colleges and universities around the country offer a program similar to RISE. Over the last decade, the WLF has hosted leaders including former U.S. President George W. Bush, former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, former Soviet Union President Mikhail Gorbachev, former Mexican President Felipe Calderon, Queen Noor of Jordan, Ambassador Caroline Kennedy and General David Petraeus. On October 3rd, the WLF welcomes former Canadian Prime Minister Stephen Harper, who served as the 22nd Prime Minister from 2006-2015. Tickets are still available () , and the event takes place on campus at Herrick Chapel. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Eileen Burke’s First Amendment Prosecution Unit Targets Free Speech, Pro-Life Protesters () Eileen O'Neill Burke, Democrat candidate for Cook County State's Attorney (Source: Illinois Review) By Illinois Review Eileen O’Neill Burke, the Democrat nominee for Cook County State’s Attorney, has unveiled a radical plan to create a “Choice Protection Unit” to target pro-life activists, which could have far-reaching consequences for free speech across Illinois. Burke’s plan, if implemented, would prioritize prosecuting pro-life activists for exercising their First Amendment rights. Instead of focusing on real crime, such as the rampant shootings and murders that have left over 1,200 people shot and more than 400 dead in Chicago this year alone, Burke’s proposed “Choice Protection Unit”—which more accurately should be called a “First Amendment Prosecution Unit”—seeks to criminalize peaceful protests outside abortion clinics. Burke’s Republican opponent, Bob Fioretti, has pledged () to uphold the law as written and crack down on real crime, like the out-of-control shootings and murders plaguing Chicago. Peter, Our democracy faces an existential crisis at the hands of Donald Trump and the MAGA Republican Party he leads. **Republicans know their extreme, regressive policies won’t win them elections — so they’ve resorted to dismantling our democratic institutions and suppressing the vote to stay in power.** We can — and will — preserve our democracy if every single one of us does just a little bit more: vote, knock doors, phone bank, postcard, drive a friend to the polls, etc. Despite all of their efforts to keep Democrats from voting, Republicans cannot prevent you from doing so. But we must make it easier — not harder — for every American to vote. That’s why I am committed to defending and expanding voting access for every American, and it’s why I just introduced the _Pre-Registration of Voters Everywhere (PROVE) Act_. The _PROVE Act_ will allow 16 and 17 year-old U.S. citizens nationwide to pre-register to vote, allowing them to automatically be added to the voter rolls upon their 18th birthdays. The right to vote is the foundation of our democracy, and the power young people have to make a difference in our elections is enormous. By making it easier for young voters across the country to pre-register to vote, the _PROVE Act_ will help encourage more Americans to make their voices heard at the ballot box. And that is democracy in its purest form. **[Will you add your name in support of the _PROVE Act_ and stand with me to protect the fundamental right to vote?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92774927/498255806/1838825884?refcode=AU_DSG_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240913_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDZkZGIwMi0yMjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lDBScr6XPJfJmFREMUyi0Ad8Emk6DdE8DFhAgyv_mGM=&emci=e7050ef2-1a72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=6d6ddb02-2272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=13556823)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92774928/498255807/1838825884?refcode=AU_DSG_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240913_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDZkZGIwMi0yMjcyLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lDBScr6XPJfJmFREMUyi0Ad8Emk6DdE8DFhAgyv_mGM=&emci=e7050ef2-1a72-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=6d6ddb02-2272-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=13556823)

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: What are your plans this weekend? We know what Jim Jordan’s are…
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
While many of us are planning to enjoy our weekends, Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA friends are busy orchestrating another crisis in Congress.
Right now, they’re on the brink of forcing a government shutdown – and instead of working on a clean spending bill, they’re tying it to a blatant voter suppression bill called the SAVE Act.
What’s the SAVE Act ?
It’s a deceptive piece of legislation designed to strip away protections for voters – making it harder for young people, working families, and minority communities to cast their ballots.
We need your help to fight back. Chip in now, and together, we can hold Jordan and ULTRA-MAGA accountable for hijacking our government and sowing constant dysfunction. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240913_government_shutdown_link1]
The truth is that they know this bill is wildly unpopular and unjust, so they’re holding the government hostage by packaging it with the must-pass spending bill, threatening a shutdown and the paychecks of millions of hardworking civil servants if they don’t get their way.
We all know how devastating a shutdown is for working people – it delays paychecks for federal employees, halts essential services, disrupts Social Security payments and veterans benefits, and even impacts food assistance programs.
And when this plan inevitably falls apart because of its sheer cruelty, you know ULTRA-MAGA will turn around and blame Democrats for the dysfunction.
This is their playbook at work: deception, chaos, and games with our democracy.
And Jim Jordan is right there, helping lead the charge.
Here’s the reality: ULTRA-MAGA knows they’re not winning this election by earning votes.
Their extreme ideas—like stripping away women’s rights, attacking reproductive freedom, slashing Social Security, and raising the retirement age – are wildly unpopular with the majority of Americans.
Instead of changing course, they’re trying to take away our free and fair elections.
They want to rig the system, suppress voters, and let Trump rule as an authoritarian.
Jim Jordan is one of Trump’s top allies in Congress, and he’s using every dirty trick to pave the way for that ULTRA-MAGA takeover.
We’ve had enough of this chaos. With your support, we can send Jordan packing and put a stop to this dangerous cycle once and for all.
Your contribution today will help us keep up the pressure, expose Jordan’s reckless agenda, and ensure our voices are heard in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240913_government_shutdown_link2]
Let’s make this weekend count—chip in now, and let’s show Jim Jordan that we’re ready to fight for a better future. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240913_government_shutdown_link3]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. subject: They called Alexandria a "fluke."
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Alexandria’s community sent her to Congress on purpose to disrupt and challenge a lot of what’s wrong in D.C.
But during her first term, many people in her own party said her election was a fluke, a mistake, and that there was “nothing to worry about.” Many believed that Alexandria would be a one-term Congresswoman.
One colleague in Congress said they were “shocked” to see how hostile her own party was towards Alexandria from the moment she arrived — and she still faces hostility to this day.
**But a shift is happening**.
Alexandria even spoke at the DNC to share this movement's message with the mainstream: **we demand a brighter future _for all_**.
Now, Alexandria already has at least one MAGA Republican opponent this November. We need to be ready to fight back against whatever else they’ll throw at us this year so we can keep pushing for real progress.

I’m writing to you hoping that this team can prove them wrong - that their dark money doesn’t always get to win. I’m hoping you will be willing to chip in to help us pay for our own response TV ad. I’ll be truthful with you, we need to raise... a lot of money this week. Apparently AOC is set on pushing her anti-Green talking points, based on her refusal to acknowledge the facts about how Greens are working to build people power - and how _her own party_ is going all out to stop us:
---

body:
Cost of living, housing affordability are top concerns for Colorado residents
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
The Rocky Mountain Rumble, hosted by Wide Open Saloon, is happening THIS SUNDAY! I will be speaking alongside some of Colorado's most outspoken freedom fighters to get out the vote this November. I'd love to see you there! [Click here to RSVP for free!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, September 13, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl

|

Heidi will be speaking at Wide Open Saloon on Sunday, September 15th alongside Congresswoman Lauren Boebert, Aurora City Councilwoman Danielle Jurinsky and candidates John Fabbricatore and Valdamar Archuleta. There will be a [great band](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), drinks, food, and fun!
